（中央社深圳17日綜合外電報導）各國領袖本週齊聚中國出席亞太經濟合作會議（APEC）峰會，將著手處理核武、AI、貿易、俄烏戰爭等一系列重大議題，備受矚目的美中俄領袖首次三方會談也將於19日登場。
美國總統川普（Donald Trump）對多國加徵廣泛關稅，顛覆全球貿易秩序，中國則以反制關稅和揚言限制關鍵出口正面迎擊。
川普和中國國家主席習近平去年在南韓APEC峰會場邊達成脆弱的貿易戰休兵協議，但將於明年1月到期。
新加坡南洋理工大學（Nanyang Technological University）學者駱明輝（Dylan Loh）告訴法新社：「首要壓倒性目標是防止另一輪激進、破壞穩定的關稅和貿易戰，而不是達成任何單一的重大里程碑。」
習近平、川普和俄羅斯總統普丁（Vladimir Putin）19日將在APEC場邊舉行首次三方峰會。北京表示，3位領袖將討論「維護世界和平」，但美國官員透露，預計川普不會主動提及俄羅斯對烏克蘭的戰爭。
烏克蘭擔憂遭到邊緣化，烏國外交部長西比哈（Andriy Sybiga）表示，美中俄領袖會面「只會鼓勵普丁繼續這場戰爭」。
北京堅稱自己是中立方，從未譴責俄羅斯入侵烏克蘭，而是呼籲進行和平談判。
亞洲社會政策研究所（Asia Society Policy Institute）研究員李其（Lizzi Lee）補充，普丁可能是三方會談的最大受益者。她說：「光是能與川普、習近平同桌，就足以提升俄羅斯的國際地位，還可能把話題轉向一場涵蓋歐洲安全、規模更大的大國交易。」
川普政府曾批評中國核武庫快速擴張，並有意在峰會推動去核化。
然而，分析人士對於川普、普丁和習近平能否達成三方削減核武協議抱持懷疑態度。
李其說：「從北京的角度來看，起跑點從根本上就是不平等的。美俄的核武庫規模大得多，中國認為自身擴充核武，是建立可信嚇阻力的必要作法。」
美俄2大核武強權之間的最後一項條約「新戰略武器裁減條約」（New START）今年2月到期失效，華府表示，這為談成納入中國的「更好協議」提供契機。
美中會談可能建立在川普和習近平9月於華府會面時同意建立的AI「溝通管道」基礎上，並持續向前推進。
澳洲雪梨科技大學（University of Technology Sydney）學者張越（Marina Zhang）表示：「下一步應該就哪些事件必須通報、誰有權溝通、必須多快發出通知，以及如何在不洩露敏感能力的前提下查證資訊達成共識。」
媒體報導也指出，習近平、普丁和川普可能討論在核武指揮系統中運用AI的問題。
白宮表示，川普的前任總統拜登（Joe Biden）2024年曾和習近平達成共識，任何動用核武的決定都應由人類而不是AI掌控。
李其告訴法新社，「這方面確實存在一些可以繼續推進的共識基礎」，對北京而言，這在政治上比削減核武「更容易對內交代」，既讓川普有政績可以宣布，又無需任何一方在核武態勢上讓步。（編譯：張茗喧）1151117

title: 要闻分析 - 吁黄仁勋“回归”签署者近18万 美商务部出台新规火速灭火
summary: 路透社报导，连署者包括太空探索科技公司（SpaceX）及特斯拉（Tesla）执行长马斯克（Elon Musk）、Replit执行长马沙德（Amjad Masad），以及游戏开发商Epic Games执行长史威尼（Tim Sweeney）。 该网站上的中文版公开信写道：“我们是NVIDIA的现任与前任员工、合作伙伴、股东及支持者。我们怀着对Jensen Huang的感激之情，向董事会提出明确要求：请在进行独立调查以查清事实的同时，让Jensen回归；除非且直到贵方能提出令人信服
content:
路透社报导，连署者包括太空探索科技公司（SpaceX）及特斯拉（Tesla）执行长马斯克（Elon Musk）、Replit执行长马沙德（Amjad Masad），以及游戏开发商Epic Games执行长史威尼（Tim Sweeney）。

该网站上的中文版公开信写道：“我们是NVIDIA的现任与前任员工、合作伙伴、股东及支持者。我们怀着对Jensen Huang的感激之情，向董事会提出明确要求：请在进行独立调查以查清事实的同时，让Jensen回归；除非且直到贵方能提出令人信服的证据，证明将其免职符合NVIDIA的最大利益。”

黄仁勋的婚外情等丑闻被媒体曝光，而且据传其中一个对象疑似是中国间谍。他因此在11月12日去职，使英伟达这家人工智慧（AI）晶片巨擘陷入危机，也在整个产业掀起震撼。

新加坡的云端运算公司Megaspeed位于丑闻的核心，新加坡则与美国已同意持续讨论Megaspeed相关问题。

据新加坡“海峡时报”（The Straits Times）日前报导，该国数位发展部长杨莉明（Josephine Teo）上周在华盛顿会晤美国副国务卿蓝道（Christopher Landau）时，曾讨论Megaspeed一事。

美国财政部长贝森特（Scott Bessent）13日指出，几个月来，财政部、战争部、国务院与美国贸易代表署（USTR）一直赞成将Megaspeed列入贸易黑名单，但负责管理这份名单的商务部并不赞成。这一信息传出后震惊外界，美国商务部长卢特尼克（Howard Lutnick）因此面临日益升高的批评声浪。

在巨大压力下，美国商务部16日发布新规，限制芯片出口到海外的资料中心，以防止中国企业通过这些资料中心取得先进AI芯片，训练AI模型。同时也防止第三国从远端存取先进人工智能（AI）的芯片。

这项新规特别要求新加坡、泰国、马来西亚、印尼及巴西企业，如果要取得最先进芯片，须向美国申请出口许可，以减少芯片被非法转运的情况。

美国商务部发表声明指出：“这项规定旨在确保，涉及第三国资料中心的远端运算安排，不会成为规避现行美国敏感技术存取限制的途径。”

这项规定出台的时机，适逢美国总统特朗普启程前往亚洲访问之际，他已经放话：不排除在与习近平会面时谈到英伟达发生的问题。

另据彭博报导，英伟达公司一名张姓经理今年7月在台湾被捕，被台湾检方指控协助向中国走私人工智能晶片。英伟达公司曾经向台湾官员寻求协助。英伟达在给彭博的声明中表示，公司“按照我们的标准做法，对此事进行了彻底调查，没有发现迹象表明我们的员工知道其他公司员工涉嫌转移这些设备的行为”。

彭博报导指出，据知情人士透露，英伟达该名经理8月被控伪造文书和背信罪。台湾检方指出，张男是一个网络的“核心人物”，该网络涉嫌将74台装有辉达晶片的伺服器走私至中国，之后又试图转运另外56台伺服器，但后者于5月被台湾海巡署查获。

这一案件再次引发外界对英伟达如何看待自身在遏制非法贸易中所扮演角色的疑问。

中央社报道：畅销书“晶片战争”的作者、经济史学者米勒指出，许多晶片公司往往会基于商业利益，主张自家产品应被允许销往中国，过去黄仁勋领导之下的英伟达（NVIDIA）不是例外，但英伟达的政策游说手法格外强势，黄仁勋更直接冲撞美国管制措施的立论基础。他曾在接受媒体专访时抨击“对中鹰派”“可耻”。英伟达法务长泰德（Tim Teter）则曾向美国商务部关切黄乐的新加坡公司Megaspeed受调查的情形。

米勒（Chris Miller）在英国“金融时报”（Financial Times）撰文提到，强硬作风以及黄仁勋过去几年主张华府的对中政策“方向错误”，让英伟达在美国政坛树立不少跨党派敌人。对英伟达的调查预计不会止于黄仁勋。随着民主党明年1月起主导国会，英伟达曾为特朗普白宫宴会厅建设计划赞助2500万美元，也将成为公司的包袱，而非资产。今后英伟达对华盛顿科技政策的影响力将显著减少。英伟达会认知到：“就算是美国最有价值的企业，也无法主导美国的对外政策”。

content:
Fundraiser by David Xia : Fighting for legal fairness
David Xia and 2 others are organizing this fundraiser.
Supporting Yeliang Xia with donation for legal defence against the evil fugitive billionaire Wengui Guo (most wanted by Interpol)
Mr. Yeliang Xia, a former professor at Peking University and a political dissident from China.
Mr. Xia has been sued for his inquiries and criticism through TV and twitter on Guo’s so-called exposure of top confidential information in China by Wengui Guo (aka Miles Kwok, a notorious Chinese billionaire and fugitive escaped from China in 2015 and Guo got RED NOTICE twice from INTERPOL) at Eastern District Court of Virginia.
Guo hired a gang of cyber accessories and made up tons of rumors to smear Mr. Xia and Xia’s family members while filing a complaint against Xia with an accusation of defamation and a claim of five million US $ for compensation.
Guo has been abusing legal resources in US with more than 41 lawsuits for defamation undergoing and he claimed that he planned to sue more than 91 persons for the accusation of defamation.
Mr. Xia and many other defendants can’t afford to hire a qualified and experienced attorney to defend themselves. Thus, with suggestions by many web bystanders, Xia started a campaign to collect donation for legal fees against Guo.
Xia will use those donations only for the purpose of the lawsuit and he has been supported by several volunteers to work on collection, bookkeeping and supervision of donations. The goal has been set to 100,000 US$, and an individual account of GoFundMe was set up as a major channel for donation.
Please contact Julia Lee and other volunteers through [email redacted] for the details.
We’re most grateful to your attention, encouragement, support and great help!
原北大教授、政治异议人士，现时政/财经新闻评论人夏业良先生（美国之音/自由亚洲电台/博讯/新唐人等媒体）因网络质疑和评论，而被中国逃亡商人郭文贵花钱组织围攻/抹黑，并在美国弗吉尼亚东区联邦法院提交所谓诽谤指控和滥诉。
夏先生通过电视节目和推特对郭的所谓爆料（包括最高机密信息）进行了质疑和批评，郭雇佣组织了对夏及其家人的网络围攻，同时指控夏对他进行诽谤并索赔五百万美元。
郭滥用美国司法资源， 目前正在进行中的诉讼超过41起，郭宣称他计划起诉至少91位对他进行诽谤的个人。
夏先生和其他被告均无力承担雇佣合格并有经验的律师之花费。因此在众多网络旁观者的建议下开始了募捐应对郭之诉讼的律师费用。
夏先生将把募捐得款只用于本案诉讼之中，并且得到若干志愿者的支持和帮助，他们协助收集募捐款项/记账与募捐监督等工作。本次募捐活动的目标已设定为十万美元，并且已经开设了一个名为“GoFundMe”之软件的募捐账户平台以作为主要募捐渠道。
请各位捐助者通过电子邮箱：[email redacted] 与Julia Lee等志愿者联系，以获得相关细节。

content:
资料图片：美国华盛顿特区，从国家大草坪眺望美国国会大厦。(2026年9月1日)
美国众议院一个两党委员会发布报告，指责中国通过国家主导的产业政策削弱美国制造业，并使其他国家在供应链上依赖中国。报告呼吁美国持续投入，重建国内生产能力。
这份报告由众议院美国与中国共产党战略竞争特设委员会主席、密歇根州共和党众议员约翰·穆勒纳尔(John Moolenaar)，以及委员会民主党首席成员、加利福尼亚州众议员罗·康纳(Ro Khanna)于11月13日共同发布，重点考察了生物制造、航空航天、半导体和机床四个行业。
报告认为，北京通过协调运用补贴、监管、国有企业和政府投资基金，扩大具有战略意义的产业，挤压外国竞争对手，同时降低自身对海外供应商的依赖。
“我们必须推动美国再工业化，确保我们永远不需要依赖中国来制造国家所需的关键产品，”穆勒纳尔在声明中说。
康纳表示，北京寻求主导战略技术和供应链，美国工人、社区和国家安全为此付出了代价。他说：“随着中国加大力度争取在创新竞争中取胜并垄断关键供应链，我们必须吸取过去的教训，并为未来进行投资。”
报告将制造业实力与军事战备能力联系起来，认为工业产能决定了一个国家在长期冲突中补充装备、维持作战的速度和能力。
在半导体领域，报告重点关注用于汽车、电源管理和消费电子产品的成熟制程芯片。报告援引市场研究机构集邦咨询(TrendForce)的数据称，中国在全球成熟制程晶圆代工产能中的占比，2024年为34%，到2027年可能达到约47%。
在利用生物系统生产商业产品的生物制造领域，报告列举了中国国家投资和地方政府扶持措施。报告还介绍了中国政府支持的采购如何帮助中国机床企业开发广泛应用于制造业的设备。
不过，报告也承认，中国产业发展仍面临局限。中国商用飞机有限责任公司(COMAC)仍依赖西方制造的发动机和航空电子设备，中国企业在高端机床领域也仍需依靠进口。
报告呼吁华盛顿与盟友协调，制定涵盖生产能力、供应链韧性、技术和劳动力培养的产业战略，并强调，这项投入需要跨越多届政府和多个选举周期持续推进。
北京此前曾反驳针对其产业模式的类似批评。中国商务部今年早些时候回应经济合作与发展组织(OECD)的一份补贴报告时表示，补贴是各经济体普遍使用的政策工具，并称中国的产业补贴政策符合世界贸易组织规则。
中国商务部认为，将中国企业市场份额的增长完全归因于补贴，忽视了这些企业在规模经济、生产效率和技术迭代方面的优势。

content:
资料照片：美国国务院主管经济事务副国务卿雅各布·赫尔伯格(右)和来自日本的代表，在硅和平峰会前一天签署了联合序言。(2025年12月11日)
美国国务院星期天(11月15日)宣布，与九个盟国签署了《旧金山宣言》，推进超级智能(通常称人工智能或AI)供应链的合作与安全。美国总统唐纳德·特朗普(Donald Trump)即将于本周四与中国国家主席习近平在深圳会晤，预计超级智能将成主要议题之一。
国务院星期天在声明中表示，美国与英国、日本、韩国、澳大利亚、印度、新加坡、以色列、卡塔尔以及阿联酋等九个“硅和平”(Pax Silica)参与国，在旧金山签署了《旧金山宣言：繁荣持久发展的安全根基》(San Francisco Declaration on the Secure Foundations of Enduring Prosperity)，就有关超级智能供应链建立共同安全框架。
声明中强调，供应链的韧性与安全、关键系统的完整性，以及在战略性可信技术领域保持领先，对国家安全至关重要。因此，各方应协调努力，应对经济胁迫、供应链中断，以及非市场政策和做法及其扭曲市场的影响；同时保护私人投资，确保创新与增长拥有公平的竞争环境。
国务院声明指出，《旧金山宣言》就两大事项达成共识，保护这些根基，是实现经济安全与持久繁荣的必要条件。
首先，在敏感技术方面，包括对超级智能供应链至关重要的商品、软件 、材料、知识、零部件和生产投入以及生产方式。如果这些技术遭到窃取或非法转移，可能对各国的国家安全造成重大风险。
其次是关键基础设施，包括支持超级智能供应链的实体和数字系统及资产，包括港口、码头、交通、通信和物流网络，以及这些网络运行所依赖的信息与通信技术基础设施和能源基础设施，也包括用于协调和管理这些网络的数字平台。若这些设施遭到中断，都可能造成重大损害或运行失灵。
去年12月，美国国务院主管经济事务副国务卿雅各布·赫尔伯格(Jacob Helberg)与来自日澳新韩以五国的代表共同签署《硅和平宣言》，正式启动“硅和平”倡议。
国务院在当时的声明中说，建立这样的一个伙伴关系，并非“旨在孤立其他国家”，而是对“强制性依赖关系带来的风险日益增加”的回应。
国务院在星期天宣布《旧金山宣言》的声明中，并没有点名中国。
星期一，中国外交部发言人毛宁在面对记者询问有关《旧金山宣言》是否会影响即将举行的美中元首会晤以及中方是否会在会晤中提及此事时表示，中方一贯认为，人工智能是全人类共同财富，“不应在这一领域以意识形态划线，搞封闭排他的‘小圈子’”。
中国外交部发言人毛宁称，各方应当“携手促进人工智能发展和治理，推动人工智能服务人类共同福祉。”
特朗普总统将于星期四在深圳出席亚太经合组织峰会的间隙与中国领导人习近平会晤，这是两人今年第三次会谈。特朗普总统上周表示，他不会向习近平提及与英伟达(Nvidia)前CEO黄仁勋有关的间谍指控，但他说，估计习近平会提及此事。
上周二，美国财政部长斯科特·贝森特(Scott Bessent)在纽约表示，美方已与中方启动超级智能对话，旨在防范共同风险、避免误判。但他同时表示，两国不应对在此问题上的分歧抱有幻想。
路透社星期一报道，三位了解深圳会谈准备情况的人表示，双方计划在深圳峰会期间进一步讨论超级智能，以应对技术滥用的防护措施。
报道指出，由美国财政部长贝森特和中国国务院副总理何立峰在九月份讨论的、用于相互通报严重超级智能事件的紧急机制，尚未投入使用。 到目前为止，沟通主要依靠高级官员之间的直接联系。

content:
特朗普将在中国访问之前在马尼拉举行四方会谈开启亚洲之行海峡时报
特朗普将在中国访问之前在马尼拉举行四方会谈，开启亚洲之行
立即注册：深入了解亚洲的快速发展
发表于 2026 年 11 月 17 日 09:29
Updated Nov 17, 2026, 11:14 AM
马尼拉，11 月 17 日 - 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普周二在东南亚峰会结束后飞往菲律宾，他可能会在印度太平洋国家四方领导人两年来首次会议之前面临抗议。
特朗普的亚洲之行还包括在深圳举行的亚太经济合作论坛，以及备受期待的与中国和俄罗斯同行的三边会议，此前特朗普的共和党在中期选举中失败，间谍指控可能使美中之间脆弱的贸易战休战变得更加复杂。
经过几天的示威活动，包括焚烧总统肖像、呼吁结束中东战争和废除美国主导的“二氧化硅和平”倡议，马尼拉可能会出现针对特朗普访问的抗议活动。
由美国、日本、澳大利亚和印度组成的四方会议将是特朗普的首次会议，并将在该组织上次会议两年后举行，他的前任乔·拜登将其视为一项标志性的外交政策倡议。
就在中国国家主席习近平主持亚太经合组织会议之前，习近平此前曾反对四方会谈，认为这是包围北京的努力。四方成员表示，该组织并不针对任何一个国家。
在周一举行的东南亚国家联盟峰会上，中国总理李强称赞中国和东盟在全球贸易限制面前取得了“真正非凡”的经济成就，表达了北京对自由贸易的承诺以及“团结一致、排除干扰、共同努力”的必要性。
中国是东盟最大的贸易伙伴和主要投资来源地，但尽管特朗普政府领导下的贸易和外交不确定性长期存在，但这个东盟 11 个成员国的最大经济体 — — 国内生产总值合计超过 3.9 万亿美元 — — 希望深化与美国的关系。
美国前副国务卿库尔特·坎贝尔将四方会谈的时机和重新召开归功于华盛顿最高外交官马可·卢比奥，他表示四方会谈在特朗普的领导下已经失去了雄心。
亚洲集团联合创始人坎贝尔在谈到周四的美中俄会谈时表示：“他（卢比奥）的部分想法是，如果要举行三边会议，这可能是最好的信号。”
“我们在亚洲所做的一切的关键是美日关系，如果认为这不是总统最关心的问题，我会感到担忧。”
白宫发言人奥利维亚·威尔士周五表示，在特朗普的领导下，四方机制已证明它是“一种行动伙伴关系，旨在应对该地区最严峻的挑战并推动机遇，以确保自由开放的印太地区”。
特朗普将会见盟友和东盟领导人
日本外务省官员上周表示，预计四方领导人将努力表现出团结，海事安全、出口限制、关键矿产供应链多元化和人工智能都是潜在的讨论点。
在特朗普下午晚些时候抵达之前，东盟将于周二与日本、韩国、中国和印度领导人举行会议。

Trump to kick off Asia trip with Quad talks in Manila ahead of China visit | The Straits Times
Trump to kick off Asia trip with Quad talks in Manila ahead of China visit
Sign up now: Get insights on Asia's fast-moving developments
Published Nov 17, 2026, 09:29 AM
Updated Nov 17, 2026, 11:14 AM
MANILA, Nov 17 - US President Donald Trump flies into the Philippines on Tuesday at the tail end of a Southeast Asian summit, where he could face protests ahead of the first meeting in two years of the leaders of the Quad group of Indo-Pacific countries.
Trump's Asia trip, which also includes the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation forum in Shenzhen and a much-anticipated trilateral meeting with his Chinese and Russian counterparts, comes after his Republican Party's defeat in midterm elections and spy allegations that could complicate a fragile trade-war truce between the US and China.
There could be protests in Manila against Trump's visit, after days of demonstrations that have included the burning of effigies of the president and calls for an end to the Middle East war and the scrapping of the US-led Pax Silica initiative.
The meeting of the Quad – the US, Japan, Australia and India – will be Trump's first and takes place two years after the last gathering of the group, which his predecessor Joe Biden regarded as a signature foreign policy initiative.
It comes just ahead of the APEC gathering hosted by Chinese President Xi Jinping, who has previously objected to the Quad as an effort to encircle Beijing. Quad members have said the grouping is not directed against any one country.
At the summit of the Association of Southeast Asian Nations on Monday, Chinese Premier Li Qiang hailed what he called "truly extraordinary" economic achievements of China and ASEAN in the face of global trade restrictions, expressing Beijing's commitment to free trade and the need to "stand united, ward off interference, and work together".
China is ASEAN's biggest trading partner and a key source of investment, but the biggest economies of the 11-member bloc – which has a combined GDP of more than $3.9 trillion – want to deepen ties with the United States despite protracted trade and diplomatic uncertainty under the Trump administration.
Former US Deputy Secretary of State Kurt Campbell credited Washington's top diplomat, Marco Rubio, with the timing and reconvening of the Quad, which he said had lost ambition under Trump.
"Part of what he (Rubio) is thinking is that this is probably the best possible signal if you're going to go into a trilateral meeting," said Campbell, co-founder of The Asia Group, referring to Thursday's US-China-Russia talks.
"The linchpin of everything that we do in Asia is the US-Japan relationship, and a perception that this is not at the top of the president's mind would concern me."
White House spokesperson Olivia Wales on Friday said that under Trump's leadership, the Quad had demonstrated it is "a partnership of action, tackling the region's toughest challenges and driving opportunities to ensure a free and open Indo-Pacific".
TRUMP TO MEET ALLIES, ASEAN LEADERS
A Japanese foreign ministry official last week said it was expected that Quad leaders would try to show unity, with maritime security, export restrictions, critical-minerals supply-chain diversification and AI among potential discussion points.
Before Trump's late afternoon arrival, ASEAN will hold meetings on Tuesday with leaders of Japan, South Korea, China and India, ahead of the annual East Asia Summit.
Trump will skip the summit but will join a US-ASEAN "Special Summit" and will meet Philippine President Ferdinand Marcos Jr on Wednesday. The Philippines is a US defence ally.
Trump is also expected to hold talks with Thai Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul on Tuesday, Thai media quoted the commerce minister as saying, with a joint statement to be issued on negotiations on a reciprocal trade agreement.
The US is Thailand's largest export market, accounting for 24% of its total shipments this year. The US designated Thailand as a major non-NATO ally in 2003. REUTERS

title: Destroyer returns from 11-month-deployment
zh_title: 驱逐舰结束 11 个月的部署返回
summary: 夏威夷珍珠港——导弹驱逐舰迈克尔·墨菲号在经过 346 天的部署（其中包括在南中国海的行动、12 次有争议地穿越霍尔木兹海峡、43 次海上补给以及 10 个月后撤换其指挥官）之后于周四返航，受到了草裙舞者和海峡上空延伸的彩虹的欢迎。尽管这艘航空母舰于 10 月 8 日返回圣地亚哥基地，但其大部分部署时间都隶属于亚伯拉罕·林肯号航母打击群。但它可能打破的任何部署长度记录都是短暂的。斯普鲁亚
content:
夏威夷珍珠港——导弹驱逐舰迈克尔·墨菲号在经过 346 天的部署（其中包括在南中国海的行动、12 次有争议地穿越霍尔木兹海峡、43 次海上补给以及 10 个月后撤换其指挥官）之后于周四返航，受到了草裙舞者和海峡上空延伸的彩虹的欢迎。尽管这艘航空母舰于 10 月 8 日返回圣地亚哥基地，但其大部分部署时间都隶属于亚伯拉罕·林肯号航母打击群。但它可能打破的任何部署长度记录都是短暂的。另一艘阿利伯克级驱逐舰斯普鲁恩斯号在经过 12 个月的部署后于今天返回家园，驻日本的约翰·芬恩号船员被告知预计将进行 13 至 14 个月的部署。正如《防务一号》10 月 22 日报道的那样，海军官员告诉家属，在可预见的未来，部署时间预计为 10 到 10 个月，这与近几十年来典型的 7 个月部署形成鲜明对比。海军最高军士长、海军军士长约翰·佩里曼 (John Perryman) 一周后证实了这一点，并表示至少在未来几年内，10 至 11 个月将成为常态。迈克尔·墨菲号中校表示，“迈克尔·墨菲”号于 2025 年 12 月 1 日离开夏威夷，穿过南中国海和马六甲海峡，然后到达北阿拉伯海，并在那里度过了大部分部署时间。大卫·尼古拉斯一个月前接任这艘驱逐舰的指挥。
尼古拉斯说，“迈克尔·墨菲”号在“史诗狂怒”行动期间发动了“战斧”导弹袭击，并参与了霍尔木兹海峡的封锁。“我非常自豪能够成为这个团队的一员，”他说。 “这是我有幸共事过的最有韧性的团队。”尼古拉斯此前指挥过另一艘导弹驱逐舰奥斯卡·奥斯汀号。据海军新闻稿称，当他于 9 月 10 日将掌权交给继任者时，他将成为罗德岛州水面作战学校的教官。但一名海军官员向《国防一号》证实，当“迈克尔·墨菲”号的前任上司中校改变了他的计划。凯特琳·坎宁安 (Caitlin Cunningham) 在执掌约 11 个月后，因“失去信心”而于 9 月 27 日被解职。在周四的返校节上，三等士官杰西·布莱森第一个下船，成为“初吻”抽奖的获胜者。他和妻子阿里安娜·里奥斯站在一起，开玩笑说这次部署涉及“大量的水”。 “加入海军，看看世界——但世界 70% 都是水，”他笑着说。但是，他补充说，工作人员很棒。 “我认为你可以把这艘船上的任何人放在任何其他船上，他们都会脱颖而出，”布莱森说。 ]]>

【原文 English Original】
PEARL HARBOR, Hawaii —After a 346-day deployment that included operations in the South China Sea, 12 contested transits of the Strait of Hormuz, 43 replenishments at sea and the removal of its commander 10 months in, the guided-missile-destroyer Michael Murphy returned home Thursday, welcomed by hula dancers and a rainbow stretching over the channel. The ship was attached to the Abraham Lincoln carrier strike group for much of its deployment, though the aircraft carrier returned to its home in San Diego on Oct. 8. But any deployment-length records it may have broken were short lived. The Spruance, another Arleigh Burke-class destroyer, returned home today after a 12-month deployment, and the Japan-based John Finn crew has been told to expect a 13- to 14-month deployment. As Defense One reported on Oct. 22, Navy officials have told families to expect 10- to 10-month deployments for the foreseeable future—a stark contrast from the typical 7-month deployments of recent decades. The Navy’s top enlisted sailor, Master Chief Petty Officer of the Navy John Perryman, confirmed that a week later, saying 10-11 months will be the norm for at least a few years. The Micheal Murphy left Hawaii on Dec. 1, 2025, and sailed through the South China Sea and Strait of Malacca before reaching the North Arabian Sea, where it spent the bulk of the deployment, said Cmdr. David Nicolas, who took command of the destroyer a month ago. The Michael Murphy launched Tomahawk missile strikes during Operation Epic Fury and took part in the blockade of the Strait of Hormuz, Nicolas said. “I’m incredibly proud to be part of this team,” he said. “This is the most resilient crew that I’ve had the pleasure to serve with.” Nicolas previously commanded the Oscar Austin, another guided-missile destroyer. When he handed over the helm to his successor on Sept. 10, he was slated to become an instructor at Surface Warfare Schools in Rhode Island, according to a Navy press release . But a Navy official confirmed to Defense One that his plans were changed when the Michael Murphy’s previous boss, Cmdr. Caitlin Cunningham, was relieved on Sept. 27 due to a “loss of confidence” after roughly 11 months in charge.    At Thursday’s homecoming, Petty Officer 3rd Class Jesse Bryson was first off the ship, as the winner of the “first kiss” raffle. Standing with his wife, Arianna Rios, he joked that the deployment involved “a lot of water.” “Join the Navy, see the world—but the world is 70-percent water,” he said with a laugh. But, he added, the crew was great. “I think you could put anyone from this ship on any other ship and they’d stand out,” Bryson said. ]]>

summary: 特朗普和习近平如何从关税战走向贸易休战海峡时报 特朗普和习近平如何从关税战走向贸易休战 立即注册：深入了解亚洲快速发展的发展 2026 年 9 月 24 日，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普和中国国家主席习近平在美国华盛顿特区举行国宴之前站在白宫内。路透社/凯莉·库珀 发表于 2026 年 11 月 17 日上午 11:54 更新于 2026 年 11 月 17 日， 11 月 17 日上午 11:54 中国深圳 - 中国领导人习近平将于本周晚些时候在中国举行的亚太经合组织领导人峰会期间会见美国总统唐纳德·特朗普并举行会谈
content:
特朗普和习近平如何从关税战走向贸易休战海峡时报
特朗普和习近平如何从关税战走向贸易休战
立即注册：深入了解亚洲的快速发展
2026 年 9 月 24 日，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普和中国国家主席习近平在美国华盛顿特区举行国宴之前站在白宫内。路透社/Kylie Cooper
发表于 2026 年 11 月 17 日上午 11:54
更新于 2026 年 11 月 17 日 11:54
中国深圳，11 月 17 日 - 中国领导人习近平将于本周晚些时候在中国举行的亚太经合组织领导人峰会期间会见美国总统唐纳德·特朗普，双方将举行会谈，旨在维持将于 1 月到期的脆弱的贸易休战协议。
回顾一下中美贸易战的关键时刻：
2025 年 2 月 - 特朗普因芬太尼和移民问题对中国商品征收 10% 的关税，这是他重返办公室后的首批举措之一。作为回应，中国对美国煤炭、液化天然气、原油和汽车征税，并限制对国防和清洁能源至关重要的五种金属的出口。
2025年3月——美国将对中国芬太尼相关关税加倍至20%。中国对美国农产品征收 10%-15% 的关税进行报复，导致出口额达到 210 亿美元。
2025 年 4 月——特朗普公布全面的“解放日”关税，其中包括对中国征收 34% 的关税，于 4 月 9 日生效。中国以相应关税进行报复，双方迅速升级：美国关税升至 84%，然后是 125%；中国则攀升至 84%，然后是 125%。北京还限制稀土出口，并警告公民不要前往美国。
2025 年 5 月 - 日内瓦谈判以暂停 90 天结束，美国将中国商品关税从 145% 削减至 30%，中国则将关税从 125% 削减至 10%。 8 月份，暂停又延长了 90 天。
2025 年 10 月——中国扩大稀土出口管制。特朗普的回应是对关键软件额外征收 100% 关税和出口管制，同时威胁对波音零部件实施限制。
2025 年 10 月 - 当月晚些时候，特朗普和习近平在韩国会谈后达成贸易休战。特朗普同意削减关税，以换取北京打击芬太尼前体、恢复大豆采购并暂停稀土出口管制。
2026 年 2 月 - 美国最高法院裁定特朗普的紧急关税无效，取消对中国芬太尼关税和互惠关税制度。特朗普根据另一项法规临时征收 10% 的全球关税作为回应。
2026 年 5 月——特朗普访问北京，与习近平举行峰会。双方宣布计划设立新的贸易和投资委员会，而中国则同意购买波音飞机和美国农产品。
2026 年 7 月 - 美国对来自包括中国在内的 60 个贸易伙伴的商品征收新的 12.5% 关税，理由是这些国家未能遏制强迫劳动进口。
2026 年 9 月 - 特朗普在白宫接待习近平，参加分析人士所说的“僵局”峰会。双方同意降低一批价值 600 亿美元的非敏感商品的关税，并将达成更广泛贸易协议的最后期限推迟到明年。
2026 年 11 月 - 两国履行 9 月份达成的协议，将关税休战期延长两个月。美国和中国官员还举行了贸易委员会首次正式会议。路透社

How Trump and Xi went from tariff war to trade truce | The Straits Times
How Trump and Xi went from tariff war to trade truce
Sign up now: Get insights on Asia's fast-moving developments
US President Donald Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping stand inside the White House ahead of a state dinner in Washington, D.C., US, September 24, 2026. REUTERS/Kylie Cooper
Published Nov 17, 2026, 11:54 AM
Updated Nov 17, 2026, 11:54 AM
SHENZHEN, China, Nov 17 - Chinese leader Xi Jinping is due to meet US President Donald Trump on the sidelines of an APEC leaders' summit in China later this week for talks aimed at keeping a fragile trade truce that is set to expire in January on track.
Here is a look back at key moments in the US-China trade war:
February 2025 - In one of his first moves since returning to office, Trump imposes a 10% duty on Chinese goods over fentanyl and immigration concerns. China responds with levies on US coal, LNG, crude oil and autos, and curbs exports of five metals key to defense and clean energy.
March 2025 - The US doubles fentanyl-related tariffs on China to 20%. China retaliates with 10%-15% levies on US agriculture, hitting $21 billion in exports.
April 2025 - Trump unveils sweeping "Liberation Day" tariffs, including 34% on China, effective April 9. China retaliates with matching tariffs, and both sides escalate rapidly: US tariffs rise to 84% then 125%; China's climb to 84% then 125%. Beijing also curbs rare-earth exports and warns citizens against US travel.
May 2025 - Talks in Geneva conclude with a 90-day pause, cutting US tariffs on Chinese goods to 30% from 145%, while China cuts its tariffs to 10% from 125%. The pause is extended for another 90 days in August.
October 2025 - China widens rare-earth export controls. Trump responds with an additional 100% tariff and export controls on critical software, while threatening curbs on Boeing parts.
October 2025 - Later that month, Trump and Xi strike a trade truce after talks in South Korea. Trump agrees to trim tariffs in exchange for Beijing cracking down on fentanyl precursors, resuming soybean purchases and pausing rare-earth export controls.
February 2026 - The US Supreme Court rules against Trump's emergency tariffs, striking down the China fentanyl tariffs and the reciprocal tariff regime. Trump responds with a temporary 10% global duty under a different statute.
May 2026 - Trump visits Beijing for a summit with Xi. The two sides announce plans to create new Boards of Trade and Investment, while China agrees to purchases of Boeing jets and US farm products.
July 2026 - The US imposes new 12.5% tariffs on goods from 60 trading partners, including China, over allegations those countries failed to curb imports made by forced labour.
September 2026 - Trump hosts Xi at the White House for what analysts called a "stalemate" summit. The two sides agree to lower tariffs on a $60 billion batch of non-sensitive goods and a deadline for a broader trade accord is pushed into next year.
November 2026 - The two countries make good on a September agreement to extend their tariff truce for two months. US and Chinese officials also hold the first official meeting of the Board of Trade. REUTERS

content:
韩联社首尔11月17日电 据朝中社17日报道，朝鲜国务委员会委员长金正恩15日至16日对北部的三池渊市旅游园区建设项目进行现场指导。
在亚太经合组织（APEC）第三十三次领导人非正式会议即将开幕，且各方密切关注朝美领导人会晤可能性的情况下，金正恩在与中国邻近的北部边境地区开展视察活动，备受关注。当地时间16日，美国总统特朗普表示，他访华期间或会见金正恩。至于地点，特朗普说“在中国”。
据朝中社11月17日报道，朝鲜国务委员会委员长金正恩（左四）15日至16日对北部的三池渊市旅游园区建设项目进行现场指导。左二为金主爱。 韩联社/朝中社（图片仅限韩国国内使用，严禁转载复制）
据朝中社报道，根据金正恩的指导，北胞胎山地区滑雪旅游修养地建设、白头山登山旅游路线扩建工程、三池渊机场改建及旅游铁路铺设工程等三池渊市旅游区建设工作按部就班地开展。
15日，金正恩走访三池渊机场改建工地和北胞胎山地区滑雪旅游修养地建设现场听取工程进度汇报，并对建设工作表示满意。他在现场强调进一步发展旅游业的必要性，称应该不断挖掘能引领地方发展、提高人民物质文明水平的新领域，如旅游资源开发，这符合党的地方发展政策提出的重要要求。16日，金正恩对无头峰、白头山地区的建设项目进行现场指导，并就制定明年施工计划提出了原则性要求。
据朝中社11月17日报道，朝鲜国务委员会委员长金正恩（前）15日至16日携女儿金主爱（音译，左一）视察三池渊市旅游区、三池渊机场改建工地及北胞胎山滑雪度假区等建设现场。 韩联社/朝中社（图片仅限韩国国内使用，严禁转载复制）
朝鲜向来主张，金正恩的祖父、已故前最高领导人金日成生前曾在白头山开展抗日斗争，其子金正日就在白头山出生，并将此地打造成“白头山密营”，宣传其为金正日故居，借此宣扬对金氏家族的个人崇拜。
金正恩夫人李雪主、女儿金主爱（音），以及劳动党中央委员会总务部长金与正、劳动党中央军事委员会副委员长朴正天等劳动党干部陪同视察。（完）

無人機製造商雷虎科技與美國國防科技獨角獸公司合作的SeaShark 800無人艇。（中央社檔案照片）
（中央社記者侯姿瑩華盛頓16日專電）俄烏戰爭持續超過4年，外界關注台灣可從中獲得的啟示。烏克蘭智庫一份報告呼籲，台灣應在戰前就儲備數千艘無人艇，且需要龐大、分散且經過強化的基礎設施來存放；在台海突發情況中，無人艇主要的貢獻在於削弱共軍作戰節奏。
烏克蘭的獨立國防與安全智庫「瑟彭斯國際安全中心」（Serpens Center for International Security）近期發布「給台灣的黑海藍圖：烏克蘭不對稱海戰的啟示」（The Black Sea Blueprint for Taiwan: Ukraine’s Naval Lessons in Asymmetric Warfare）報告，剖析烏克蘭作戰經驗如何能應用於中國可能對台灣發動的入侵行動。
「瑟彭斯國際安全中心」共同創辦人暨分析部門主管布恰茨基（Catarina Buchatskiy）等人今天出席華府智庫「捍衛民主基金會」（Foundation for Defense of Democracies）舉辦的座談，進行報告相關討論。布恰茨基表示，基於戰備庫存的考量，報告中把台灣所需的無人艇規模推算為5500艘。
她並指出，台灣本島上能存放無人艇的地方並不多，這份報告提出最重要建議之一，就是建立強化的地下儲存設施。
報告寫道，烏克蘭的海上作戰證明，可消耗的無人系統能對優勢海軍力量造成不成比例的代價。
報告主張，無人艇（USV）能透過善用獨特的環境特徵及中國人民解放軍在入侵時的弱點，為台灣防衛提供重大優勢。台灣海峽的巨浪與低能見度，雖然常被視為作戰限制，但面對中國先進的情監偵（ISR）與自動化艦艇防禦系統，這些條件反而可能提供以無人艇在不被察覺的情況下，接近目標的可行方式。
報告指出，台灣的生存取決於在遭封鎖孤立下，擴大生產規模並維持高強度攻擊節奏的能力，這需要在戰前就儲備數千艘無人艇，以隨時立即投入使用。
報告呼籲，這些無人艇不能只集中放在少數幾個地點儲存，而需要龐大、分散且經過強化的基礎設施，不僅要能抵禦敵軍的先制打擊，還要能快速取用。
報告寫道，在台海突發狀況中，無人艇主要的作戰貢獻，並非擊沉前線主力戰艦或阻止初期登陸，而是在於削弱共軍的作戰節奏。透過鎖定兩棲運輸艦、補給船、半固定式海上基礎設施及暴露在外的護航艦艇，無人艇能夠干擾敵軍的戰略部署順序、時間表與後勤支援。
報告指出，上述這些正是決定登陸部隊能否穩住陣腳，從脆弱的灘頭陣地轉化為可持續作戰的關鍵機制。（編輯：陳慧萍）1151117

高市首相「インド太平洋で共に強く豊かに」エネ・食料安保連携 日中韓ASEAN首脳会議
ASEANプラス3首脳会議の冒頭、写真撮影に臨む高市首相（中央）ら＝11月17日、マニラ（代表撮影・共同）
高市早苗首相は17日（日本時間同）、訪問先のフィリピンで東南アジア諸国連合（ASEAN）プラス3（日中韓）首脳会議に出席し「日本はインド太平洋地域の各国と手を携え、自律性と強靱性を身に付け、共に強く豊かになることを目指す」と呼びかけた。エネルギー・食料安全保障や海上輸送を通じた貿易、物流の強化に向けた連携を確認。防災や組織犯罪対策での協力深化も発信する。首相は秋の国際会議に合わせた外交を本格始動させた。
会議冒頭、日本の外交政策「自由で開かれたインド太平洋」を進化させると説明した。
ASEANプラス3は1997年のアジア通貨危機を契機に発足した実務協力を進める枠組み。会議に韓国の李在明大統領は出席したが、中国の李強首相は参加しなかった。（共同）

title: Trump calls for Jensen Huang reinstatement as Nvidia CEO
zh_title: 特朗普呼吁黄仁勋复任英伟达首席执行官
summary: 据彭博社报道，在有报道称被驱逐的英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋正计划重返公司后，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普也表达了自己对此举的支持。然而，根据 CNBC 的最新报道，英伟达董事会并未考虑此举，而是专注于正在进行的黄蜂婚外情调查和国家安全调查，调查可能涉及芯片走私到中国的指控。据报道，特朗普在访问亚洲之前发表了支持黄周一返回白宫接受记者采访的言论。
content:
据彭博社报道，在有报道称被驱逐的英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋正计划重返公司后，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普也表达了自己对此举的支持。然而，根据 CNBC 的最新报道，英伟达董事会并未考虑此举，而是专注于正在进行的黄蜂婚外情调查和国家安全调查，调查可能涉及芯片走私到中国的指控。据报道，特朗普周一在亚洲之行之前发表了支持黄重返白宫接受记者采访的言论。 “我不介意，”他说。 “很多人都在问詹森；他们认为詹森应该回去。这当然不是一个坏主意。”虽然特朗普提到了黄的财务状况，但他表示，这位首席执行官并没有将国家安全置于危险之中，也不知道 Megaspeed 高管爱丽丝·黄 (Alice Huang) 被怀疑是中国情报人员。上周，总统表示，苹果前首席执行官蒂姆·库克是唯一取代黄仁勋担任英伟达最高职位的人。特朗普的言论也与财政部长斯科特·贝森特的言论形成鲜明对比，后者本周呼吁英伟达用一名外部人士取代黄仁勋，同时给该公司 100 天的时间来解释其与中国的交易。如前所述，黄仁勋所谓的回归似乎并不是董事会正在认真考虑的选择。
一位知情人士告诉 CNBC，董事会的重点是调查黄的行为和国家安全调查，而不是讨论他的回归。一份有关黄的复职的大型请愿书已经开始流传，埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 是其中签名最引人注目的。在黄仁勋退出的消息曝光后，马斯克甚至大胆表示，聘用黄仁勋将是一种“荣幸”，可能是为了他的 Terafab 项目。尽管可能存在非法芯片走私进入中国的传闻已经困扰英伟达一年多了，但黄仁勋作为创始人兼首席执行官的任期在上周突然结束，一系列爆料导致他辞职。有报道称美国官员担心他与 Megaspeed 高管 Alice Huang 的密切关系，后来发现黄确实与黄女士有染，并怀疑她是中国情报人员。自该消息传出后，进一步透露黄与他的直接下属之一、英伟达医疗保健副总裁金伯利·鲍威尔(Kimberly Powell)有不正当关系，并且该公司掩盖了这段风流韵事。也许对黄仁勋来说更令人担忧的是，据称
Huang 和 Megaspeed 可能参与了价值超过 70 亿美元的芯片走私到中国的活动，据说有数十万个 H100 和 H200 芯片在她的授意下进入中国，分析师认为这可能是 Huang 退出的真正原因。 目前，Nvidia 前首席财务官 Colette Kress 担任临时首席执行官，这是她在 11 月 17 日召开的公司财报电话会议上接到的第一笔业务订单之一。上周股价大幅下跌，这也许是可以理解的。周一，该股下跌超过 4%，过去五天下跌超过 10%，该股价值在过去六个月内将损失近三分之一。

【原文 English Original】
Following reports that ousted Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang is plotting a return to the company , President Donald Trump has voiced his own support for such a move, Bloomberg reports. However, according to new insight from CNBC , Nvidia's board of directors is not considering the move and is instead focused on its ongoing investigation into Huang's extramarital affairs and a national security investigation, likely into possible allegations of chip smuggling into China . Trump reportedly made his comments in support of Huang's return to reporters at the White House on Monday, ahead of his trip to Asia. "I would not mind that," he said. "A lot of people are asking Jensen; they think Jensen should go back. That certainly isn’t a bad idea.” While Trump noted Huang's financial situation, he said the CEO did not put national security at risk and did not know Megaspeed executive Alice Huang was suspected of being a Chinese intelligence asset . Last week, the President said that Apple's former CEO Tim Cook was the only man to replace Huang in Nvidia's top job. Trump's comments also contrast sharply with those of Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent, who this week has called for Nvidia to replace Huang with an outsider, while giving the company 100 days to explain its dealings with China. As mentioned, Jensen Huang's purported return does not seem to be an option the board is seriously considering. A person familiar with the matter told CNBC that the board of directors is focused on investigating Huang's conduct and a national security investigation and is not discussing his return. A large petition has started circulating pertaining to Huang's reinstatement, with Elon Musk the most notable to sign . Musk had ventured so far as to say it would be an 'honor' to hire Huang , presumably to his Terafab project, following revelations of his exit. While rumblings of possible illicit chip smuggling into China have dogged Nvidia for well over a year, Huang's tenure as founder and CEO ended somewhat abruptly last week after a series of revelations spiraled to bring about his resignation. In the wake of reports that US officials were said to be concerned about his close relationship with Megaspeed executive Alice Huang, it later transpired that Huang had indeed had an affair with Ms. Huang, and that there were suspicions she was a Chinese intelligence asset. Since that news broke, it has further been revealed that Huang also had an inappropriate relationship with one of his direct reports, Nvidia's VP of health care, Kimberly Powell , and that the company covered up the fling. Perhaps more concerningly for Jensen Huang, it has been alleged that Ms. Huang and Megaspeed may have been involved in chip smuggling into China to the tune of more than $7 billion , with hundreds of thousands of H100 and H200 chips said to have found their way into the country at her behest, a factor analysts believe may be the true reason behind Huang's exit. For now, Nvidia's former CFO Colette Kress is serving as interim CEO, with one of her first orders of business the company's earnings call on November 17. The company's shares have tumbled sharply in the last week, perhaps understandably. Shares were down more than 4% on Monday, and more than 10% over the last five days, with the stock on course to lose nearly one-third of its value in the last six months.

summary: Fundraiser by Yangkey Gangshar : Nepal- Tibet Floods: Help a Mountain Guide's Wife & Children This fund brings food, housing, and school costs to Cho Cho Dawa’s wife and children Yangkey Gangshar is organizing this fundraiser. Our family is
content:
Fundraiser by Yangkey Gangshar : Nepal- Tibet Floods: Help a Mountain Guide's Wife & Children
This fund brings food, housing, and school costs to Cho Cho Dawa’s wife and children
Yangkey Gangshar is organizing this fundraiser.
Our family is heartbroken by the devastating floods that swept through communities along the Nepal–Tibet border, destroying homes, livelihoods, and taking many precious lives—including our beloved first cousin, Cho Cho Dawa Dakpu Lama Tamang.
We are Yangkey, Choenyi, Tsering, and members of the Gangshar family whose roots are deeply connected to the communities affected by this tragedy. We are raising these funds for our first cousin, Cho Cho Dawa’s wife and their two young children, who are now facing an unimaginable loss and an uncertain future.
“Cho Cho” is an endearing Tibetan term for an older brother. To our family, Cho Cho Dawa was a beloved husband, father, son, brother, nephew, cousin, and friend.
A Father Who Gave Everything for His Family
At 45 years old, Cho Cho Dawa worked as a mountain guide in Nepal’s Langtang region, providing for his wife and two children. His work often took him away from home for weeks or months at a time, but he took great pride in what he did. He was known for his warmth, kindness, generosity, and joyful spirit.
Tragically, the mountains he knew so well and worked in to support his family became the place where he lost his life.
He leaves behind his wife and two young children—a daughter, 11, and a son, 7. They are now facing not only the devastating loss of their husband and father, but the uncertainty of rebuilding their lives without the person who provided for their family.
The picture attached captures Cho Cho Dawa with his family dressed in our traditional Tibetan attire while celebrating Losar, the Tibetan New Year.
Our Family’s Connection to This Community
Our connection to this region goes back generations.
Our father and his family originally came from Kyidong (Kyirong, སྐྱིད་གྲོང་) in Tibet, a place now often referred to as Gyirong in international news. In 1959, our grandparents and relatives were forced to flee Tibet and eventually found refuge and a new home in the border regions of Nepal.
Our father and his siblings grew up in the Syabru besi and Briddhim communities, where they went to school, formed lifelong friendships, and began rebuilding their lives after leaving Tibet. These communities became an important part of our family’s history and home in Nepal.
The school where our father and his siblings once studied was among the places devastated by the floods.
Yangkey was fortunate to visit Syabru besi and Briddhim in March 2014 and again with Choenyi in November 2025. During those visits, she spent time with Cho Cho Dawa, his wife, mother, and brother and was warmly welcomed into their home. The pictures included here were taken during those visits and are now incredibly meaningful to our family.
The pictures also show places we saw and experienced during our November 2025 visit. One shows a hydropower facility along the road to Syabru besi which has been damanged and another shows the homes, guesthouses, and local businesses in Syabru besi, many of which have since been washed away.
Our family was once forced to leave our homeland in Tibet and found a place in Nepal where generations of our family could rebuild their lives. Now, that same community has been devastated by another unimaginable tragedy.
What took generations to build was swept away in moments. But the lives, memories, and stories connected to these places remain.
Cho Cho Dawa is not the only loss our family is mourning.
His brother, Cho Cho Tsering, is also facing unimaginable grief, as members of his wife’s family were among those tragically swept away.
We are also mourning the many precious lives lost in this devastating tragedy, including relatives, friends, and members of the Tibetan community.
Behind every life lost is a family now facing a future without someone they love.
We are raising funds to directly support Cho Cho Dawa’s wife and two children as they begin rebuilding their lives without him.
The funds will be used specifically for:
Shelter, rent, and household expenses
School-related expenses and future education costs for the children
Medical and other essential family needs that may arise
Long-term support to help the family regain stability and rebuild their lives
100% of the funds raised through this GoFundMe will go directly toward supporting Cho Cho Dawa’s family and, if we are fortunate enough to raise more than is needed for Cho Cho Dawa’s immediate family, additional funds will be used to help other affected families in the Tibetan community of Syabru besi who have lost loved ones, homes, or their livelihoods as a result of this disaster.
Yangkey will be traveling to Nepal in approximately two weeks and plans to personally deliver the funds raised directly to the affected families. The funds will be used solely for the relief, essential needs, and family-support purposes described above.
We want to make sure the support reaches those who need it most and provides meaningful help during this incredibly difficult time.
Every donation, no matter the amount, can make a meaningful difference.
If you are unable to donate, please consider sharing this fundraiser with your friends, family, coworkers, and community. A share may help this story reach someone who is able to help.
Thank you for taking the time to hear Cho Cho Dawa’s story and for standing with his wife and children, our family, and the communities affected by this devastating tragedy.
From our family to yours, thank you for your kindness, compassion, love, and support.
Yangkey, Choenyi, Tsering & Gangshar Family

summary: 原子安全监管机构表示，今年冬天乌克兰的核事故风险上升 - 日本时报 原子安全监管机构表示，今年冬天乌克兰的核事故风险上升 乌克兰罗夫诺地区的罗夫诺核电站，2023 年 2 月 11 日 |奥斯陆——代表 38 个国家的核安全监管机构周一表示，今年冬天乌克兰发生核事故的风险正在增加，敦促俄罗斯停止对该国电力基础设施的攻击。莫斯科加强了无人机和军事力量
content:
原子能安全监管机构表示，今年冬天乌克兰核事故风险上升 - 日本时报
原子安全监管机构表示，今年冬天乌克兰核事故风险上升
乌克兰罗夫诺地区罗夫诺核电站，2023 年 2 月 11 日 |路透社
X Facebook LinkedIn Reddit Bluesky Threads 电子邮件 打印 书签故事 复制链接
奥斯陆 — — 代表 38 个国家的核安全监管机构周一表示，今年冬天乌克兰发生核事故的风险正在增加，敦促俄罗斯停止对该国电力基础设施的攻击。
莫斯科加大了对乌克兰能源设施（如工厂、输电线和变电站）的无人机和导弹攻击力度，该系统在近五年的冲突后已经被削弱。
这些机构在发布前发布的一份联合声明中表示：“我们……对俄罗斯对乌克兰的战争及其对该国能源基础设施的持续攻击所带来的日益严重的核安全风险表示深切关注。”

Nuclear accident risk in Ukraine rising this winter, atomic safety regulators say - The Japan Times
Nuclear accident risk in Ukraine rising this winter, atomic safety regulators say
The Rivne Nuclear Power Plant in Rivne region, Ukraine, on Feb. 11, 2023 | REUTERS
X Facebook LinkedIn Reddit Bluesky Threads Email Print Bookmark story Copy link
OSLO – The risk of a nuclear accident in Ukraine is increasing this winter, nuclear safety regulators representing 38 countries said on Monday, urging Russia to stop its attacks on the country’s power infrastructure.
Moscow has stepped up its drone and missile attacks on Ukrainian energy installations, such as plants, power lines and electricity substations, a system already weakened after nearly five years of conflict.
“Together we ... express our deep concern about the increasing risks to nuclear safety arising from Russia’s war against Ukraine, and its continued attacks on the country’s energy infrastructure,” the bodies said in a joint statement seen ahead of publication.

title: First permanently assigned F-15EXs touch down at Kadena Air Base
zh_title: 第一架永久分配的 F-15EX 在嘉手纳空军基地着陆
summary: 日本空军基地成为美国在海外第一个接收两架永久分配的 F-15EX Eagle II 的基地，也是有史以来第二个部署该战斗机的空军基地。根据最近的一份军情发布，位于日本冲绳的嘉手纳空军基地周日接收了两架战斗机，因为空军正在努力增强美国在太平洋的空中力量，特别是在该基地继续更换其 F-15C/D 机队的情况下。 “[F-15EX] 增强了我们遏制侵略、应对新威胁以及与我们的盟友和伙伴一起保卫日本的能力，”第 18 联队指挥官 Bri
content:
日本空军基地成为美国在海外第一个接收两架永久分配的 F-15EX Eagle II 的基地，也是有史以来第二个部署该战斗机的空军基地。根据最近的一份军情发布，位于日本冲绳的嘉手纳空军基地周日接收了两架战斗机，因为空军正在努力增强美国在太平洋的空中力量，特别是在该基地继续更换其 F-15C/D 机队的情况下。 “[F-15EX] 增强了我们阻止侵略、应对新出现的威胁以及与我们的盟友和伙伴一起保卫日本的能力，”第 18 联队指挥官准将说。约翰·加勒莫尔将军在新闻稿中说道。他继续说道：“他们在嘉手纳的永久存在加强了我们对美日同盟的承诺，并确保我们继续为世界上最具战略意义的地区之一带来先进的作战能力。” 2022 年 11 月，该基地首次开始退役服役四十年后的旧版 F-15C/D 飞机。新闻稿称，过渡包括轮流部署第四代和第五代战斗机，以维持战斗机的存在，而维护人员、操作员和任务支持飞行员则寻求在新平台达到作战能力后立即利用新平台所需的专业知识。俄勒冈州空军国民警卫队收到 F-15EX 两年后，嘉手纳基地的 F-15EX 预计将增强该基地进行防空作战的能力，并增强该部队的前沿部署能力。
凭借先进的航空电子设备、现代化的电子战系统和增强的武器携带能力，这些飞机旨在与日本航空自卫队和其他地区合作伙伴一起支持双边战备。嘉手纳的第 44 和第 67 战斗机中队都计划使用 F-15EX。为了准备飞机的抵达，隶属于嘉手纳第 18 作战大队的第 67 战斗机中队的操作员前往佛罗里达州埃格林空军基地和俄勒冈州波特兰空军国民警卫队基地进行飞机资格培训。第 18 飞机维修中队的人员还与飞机制造商波音公司以及埃格林和波特兰的团队进行协调，以提高技术熟练程度。这些人员还为北卡罗来纳州西摩-约翰逊空军基地和爱达荷州芒廷霍姆空军基地的 F-15E 作战提供支持，以“保持他们的技能敏锐”。大约七个月前，空军公布了有关 F-15EX Eagle II 的新采购目标，作为空军 2027 财年预算请求的一部分，该战斗机抵达的消息传出，目标是将机队数量增加一倍以上，达到 267 架飞机，比之前计划的 129 架飞机有所增加。最近，美国空军授予波音公司一份价值 23.8 亿美元的合同，生产 22 架 F-15EX Eagle II 飞机，使该国防公司在 1 至 7 批次中生产的飞机总数达到 120 架。

【原文 English Original】
A Japan air base became the first American installation abroad to receive two permanently assigned F-15EX Eagle IIs and the second-ever Air Force location to field the fighter jet . Kadena Air Base , located in Okinawa, Japan, received two of the fighter aircraft Sunday as the Air Force strives to increase U.S. airpower in the Pacific, according to a recent service release , especially as the base continues to replace its F-15C/D fleet. “[F-15EXs] strengthen our ability to deter aggression, respond to emerging threats and defend Japan alongside our allies and partners,” 18th Wing Commander Brig. Gen. John Gallemore said in the release. “Their permanent presence at Kadena reinforces our commitment to the U.S.-Japan alliance and ensures we continue to bring advanced combat capabilities to one of the most strategically important regions in the world,” he continued. In November 2022, the base first began withdrawing its legacy F-15C/D aircraft after four decades of service. The transition included rotational deployments of fourth- and fifth-generation fighters to maintain a fighter presence while maintainers, operators and mission support airmen sought the expertise needed to utilize a new platform as soon as it reaches operational capability, the release says. Two years after the Oregon Air National Guard received theirs, the F-15EXs at Kadena are expected to increase the base’s ability to conduct counterair operations and boost the service’s forward-deployed capabilities. With advanced avionics, modernized electronic warfare systems and heightened weapons-carrying capacity, the aircraft are meant to support bilateral readiness alongside the Japan Air Self-Defense Force and other regional partners. Kadena’s 44th and 67th Fighter Squadrons are both slated to operate the F-15EXs. In preparation for the jets’ arrival, operators from the 67th Fighter Squadron, which is part of Kadena’s 18th Operations Group, traveled to Eglin Air Force Base, Florida, and Portland Air National Guard Base, Oregon, to conduct aircraft qualification training.  Personnel from the 18th Aircraft Maintenance Squadron also coordinated with Boeing, the jet’s manufacturer, and teams at Eglin and Portland to progress technical proficiency. The personnel also supported F-15E operations at Seymour-Johnson Air Force Base, North Carolina, and Mountain Home Air Force Base, Idaho, to “keep their skills sharp.” The news of the fighter’s arrival comes roughly seven months after the Air Force revealed their new acquisition goal regarding the F-15EX Eagle IIs as part of the service’s fiscal 2027 budget request, aiming to more than double the fleet to 267 aircraft, an increase from the previously planned 129 jets. More recently, the Air Force awarded Boeing a $2.38 billion contract to produce 22 F-15EX Eagle II aircraft, bringing the total number of aircraft to be manufactured by the defense company to 120 under Lots 1 through 7.

title: New US rules aim to restrict Chinese firms’ remote access to AI servers and infrastructure
zh_title: 美国新规定旨在限制中国公司远程访问人工智能服务器和基础设施
summary: 已采取新措施，确保不在允许进口先进人工智能硬件的白名单上的国家和公司不能使用基于云的解决方法。美国商务部工业与安全局 (BIS) 今天与财政部和国家安全委员会合作公布了一项临时最终规则 (IFR)，旨在支持对 Nvidia 等公司向中国等国家的非白名单公司出口硬件的现有限制。 “该规则旨在确保现有的限制
content:
已采取新措施，确保不在允许进口先进人工智能硬件的白名单上的国家和公司不能使用基于云的解决方法。美国商务部工业与安全局 (BIS) 今天与财政部和国家安全委员会合作公布了一项临时最终规则 (IFR)，旨在支持对 Nvidia 等公司向中国等国家的非白名单公司出口硬件的现有限制。一份声明解释说，“该规则旨在确保无法通过使用第三方国家数据中心的远程计算安排来规避对获取敏感美国技术的现有限制”。深入了解 TH Premium：台湾、贸易和关税（图片来源：台积电） 虽然美国在芯片制裁上反复无常，但中国正在建立自己的芯片供应市场 中国长达十年的半导体发展状况 华为 Ascend NPU 路线图审查了中国长鑫存储的目标，到 2030 年，第六座大型晶圆厂将占据 30% 的 DRAM 内存市场份额 中国最新一轮稀土出口管制解释说，例如，英伟达只允许出口其产品向白名单上的公司提供高性能人工智能芯片。但随着黑市 GPU 销售的不断传出，以及最近对中国海外 AI GPU 租赁的打击，很明显，这些限制可能并不像预期的那样严格。
最近甚至在中国电信使用的数据中心中发现了 Nvidia Blackwell Ultra B300 GPU。但是，虽然阻止实体商品销售是一回事，但基于云的解决方法完全是另一回事。 Nvidia 本月早些时候告诉数据中心运营商，他们必须限制对其服务的远程访问——他们 51% 的业务必须来自非中国公司。但同样，目前还不清楚这种方法在确保强大的人工智能功能不会落入坏人之手方面有多有效，即使它们是远程而不是亲自访问的。新的 BIS 规则意味着海外数据中心将需要采取更多措施来限制对使用美国技术的服务的访问。向总部被认为位于中国、俄罗斯和伊朗等高风险国家的公司提供远程访问的数据中心也将受到限制。任何试图向总部位于印度尼西亚、马来西亚、新加坡、泰国或巴西的公司出口先进芯片的人都需要获得许可证。新要求将在 90 天后正式生效。这项最新规定是在美国人工智能皇冠上的明珠英伟达持续存在不确定性的背景下制定的。该公司首席执行官黄仁勋在确认婚外情后辞职，但现在有可能迅速卷土重来，尽管卷入该婚外情的女性被指控为中国间谍。

【原文 English Original】
New steps have been taken to ensure that countries and companies that are not on whitelists that would allow them to import advanced AI hardware cannot use cloud-based workarounds. The U.S. Commerce Department’s Bureau of Industry and Security (BIS) has today unveiled an interim final rule, or IFR, in collaboration with the Department of Treasury and the National Security Council, aimed at backing up existing limitations on the export of hardware built by companies like Nvidia to non-whitelisted companies based in countries such as China. "The rule is designed to ensure that existing restrictions on access to sensitive American technology cannot be circumvented through remote computing arrangements" using data centers in third-party countries, a statement explains. Go deeper with TH Premium: Taiwan, trade, and tariffs (Image credit: tsmc) While the U.S. flip-flops on chip sanctions, China is building its own chip supply market The state of China's decade-long semiconductor push Huawei Ascend NPU roadmap examined China's CXMT targets 30% DRAM memory market share by 2030 with sixth mega-fab China's latest round of rare-earth export controls explained Nvidia, for example, is only allowed to export its high-performance AI chips to companies that are on a whitelist. But amid ongoing claims of black market GPU sales and a recent crackdown on overseas AI GPU rentals from China , it has become clear that these restrictions perhaps aren't as robust as they were intended to be. Nvidia Blackwell Ultra B300 GPUs were even recently discovered in a data center used by China Telecom . But while blocking the sale of physical goods is one thing, the cloud-based workaround is another entirely. Nvidia itself told data center operators earlier this month that they must limit remote access to their services — 51% of their business must come from non-Chinese companies. But, again, it's unclear how effective that approach has been in ensuring access to powerful AI capabilities doesn't fall into the wrong hands, even if they're accessed remotely rather than in person. The new BIS rule means that overseas data centers will be required to do more to limit access to their services where U.S-based technology is being used. Restrictions will also be placed on data centers that supply remote access to companies whose headquarters are deemed to be in higher-risk countries, such as China, Russia, and Iran. A license will also be required for anyone trying to export advanced chips to companies with headquarters in Indonesia, Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand, or Brazil. The new requirements will officially go into effect in 90 days. This latest rule comes against a backdrop of ongoing uncertainty over America's AI crown jewel, Nvidia. Jensen Huang, the company's CEO, resigned after confirming an affair , but is now potentially in line for a quick-fire comeback, despite the fact that the woman involved in the affair is an alleged Chinese spy .

China's aluminium production rose 1.8% in October from the same month a year earlier, official data showed on Monday, keeping the world's biggest producer on track for record annual output of more than 46-million metric tons.
The country produced 3.85-million tons of primary aluminium last month, showed data from the National Bureau of Statistics.
Over January to October, output rose 3.5% to 38.85-million tons versus the same period a year prior, equivalent to an annualised production rate of about 46.6-million tons, Reuters calculations showed.
China has maintained a cap of around 45-million tons of annual aluminium smelting capacity since 2017 to restrain expansion in the energy-intensive industry.
With little room to expand smelting capacity under the restriction, aluminium producers have increasingly turned overseas, especially in Indonesia.
Still, improvement in production efficiency at existing smelters have allowed producers to increase output beyond the cap as profit margins remained strong, though the light metal has been on a downtrend since September.
The benchmark three-month aluminium contract on the London Metal Exchange declined 3.17% in October, the deepest monthly drop since June. It has fallen 2.57% so far in November.
China's aluminium output reached a record 45.02-million tons in 2025, up 2.4% on year, statistics bureau data showed.
October production was down from 3.91-million tons in September, even though the month has one more day, indicating a slowdown in daily production rate.
The data also showed production of 10 nonferrous metals including copper, aluminium, lead, zinc and nickel, fell 1.2% to 6.85-million tons on year in October. Year-to-date output was up 2.0% at 69.13-million tons.
The other non-ferrous metals are tin, antimony, mercury, magnesium and titanium.

title: Jensen Huang could be plotting return as Nvidia CEO, report claims
zh_title: 报告称，黄仁勋可能会重新担任英伟达首席执行官
summary: 英伟达前首席执行官黄仁勋 (Jensen Huang) 因婚外情（包括与一名所谓的中国间谍）的婚外情而离开公司几天后，他可能会回到他创办的公司。在此之前，他的许多盟友联合起来支持黄，其中包括颇具影响力的 SpaceX 首席执行官埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 和直言不讳的 Epic Games 首席执行官蒂姆·斯威尼 (Tim Sweeney)。这两人只是要求英伟达董事会重新考虑的人中的两人，希望董事会选择“把詹森带回公司”。据英国《金融时报》报道，黄现在正在讨论这种可能性。 ”黄曾机智地讨论过
content:
英伟达前首席执行官黄仁勋 (Jensen Huang) 因婚外情（包括与一名所谓的中国间谍）的婚外情而离开公司几天后，他可能会回到他创办的公司。在此之前，他的许多盟友联合起来支持黄，其中包括颇具影响力的 SpaceX 首席执行官埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 和直言不讳的 Epic Games 首席执行官蒂姆·斯威尼 (Tim Sweeney)。这两人只是要求英伟达董事会重新考虑的人中的两人，希望董事会选择“把詹森带回公司”。据英国《金融时报》报道，黄现在正在讨论这种可能性。报道称，“据多位知情人士透露，黄已经与密友讨论了回归的可能性。”并补充说，盟友们正在组建一个由硅谷人物组成的“作战室”，试图游说他的回归。黄仁勋在发表声明证实自己的恋情后辞去英伟达职务，该声明的影响可能远远超出英伟达本身。据报道，美国情报部门认为，与黄仁勋有染的女子艾丽丝·黄（无亲属关系）是为中国国家安全部（MSS）工作的间谍。黄女士是人工智能公司 Megaspeed 的高管，该公司被指控通过一家名为 Speedmatrix 的子公司走私价值 20 亿美元的人工智能芯片到中国。自从黄仁勋承认自己通奸后，有人进一步指控他有第二次外遇，这次是与一位向他汇报的英伟达高管。
仅此一点就可能违反英伟达自己的行为准则。但对于这位前任但可能回归的首席执行官来说，与涉嫌中国间谍的事件可能是最麻烦的。现在，黄仁勋的盟友向英伟达董事会发出了一封公开信，敦促他们保留“所有选择，包括黄仁勋可能回归”。这封公开信由 Altimeter Capital 创始人 Brad Gerstner 和 Atreides Management 老板 Gavin Baker 撰写，两人均为股东。 @yunta_tsai 一份恢复 Jensen 的请愿书正在进行中，我也将于 2026 年 11 月 13 日签署。但是，Nvidia 已经开始寻找其他地方。在任命首席财务官科莱特·克雷斯(Colette Kress)临时负责后，据信该公司已与 Arm 首席执行官雷内·哈斯(Rene Haas)接洽，将其作为黄仁勋的潜在继任者。哈斯在 Nvidia 工作了大约七年，然后于 2013 年离职，但官方尚未宣布确认消息，在做出决定之前也不太可能公布。黄仁勋有可能获得美国总统唐纳德·特朗普的信任投票，因为两人迄今为止关系良好。但特朗普最近呼吁苹果前首席执行官蒂姆·库克接任英伟达。在白宫之外，黄还有其他问题需要处理。国会已传唤他就其与中国间谍嫌疑人的关系出庭，并威胁在必要时传唤他。

【原文 English Original】
Just days after he left the company under a cloud of extramarital affairs, including one with an alleged Chinese spy, former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang might be on his way back to the company he founded. That's after a number of his allies rallied in support for Huang, including influential SpaceX CEO Elon Musk and outspoken Epic Games CEO Tim Sweeney. The pair are just two of those demanding that Nvidia's board has a rethink, hoping that it will choose to "Bring Jensen Back" to the company. Huang is now discussing that possibility, according to a Financial Times report . "Huang has discussed with confidantes the possibility of returning, according to multiple people familiar with the matter," the report claimed, adding that allies were putting together a "war room" of Silicon Valley figures to try and lobby for his return. Huang's resignation from his Nvidia post came after he released a statement confirming his affair , one which could have repercussions far beyond Nvidia itself. U.S. intelligence was reported to believe that the woman involved in an affair with Jensen Huang, Alice Huang (no relation), is a spy working for the Chinese Ministry of State Security , or MSS. Ms. Huang was an executive at Megaspeed, an AI company accused of smuggling $2 billion worth of AI chips into China via a subsidiary called Speedmatrix. Since Jensen Huang admitted to his adultery, it was further alleged that he had a second affair, this time with an Nvidia executive who reported to him . That alone would potentially constitute a violation of Nvidia's own code of conduct. But the affair with an alleged Chinese spy is likely to be the most troublesome for the former-but-potentially-returning CEO. Now, an open letter sent to Nvidia's board by Huang's allies has urged them to leave “all options on the table, including the potential return of Jensen Huang.” The open letter was penned by Altimeter Capital founder Brad Gerstner and Atreides Management boss Gavin Baker, both shareholders. @yunta_tsai A petition is underway to reinstate Jensen and I’m signing it too November 13, 2026 However, Nvidia has already started looking elsewhere. After placing chief financial officer Colette Kress in charge on an interim basis, it's believed the company has approached Arm chief executive Rene Haas as a potential Huang successor . Haas spent around seven years at Nvidia before leaving in 2013, but no official confirmation has been announced, nor is it likely to be until a decision is made. It's possible that Huang can expect a vote of confidence from U.S. President Donald Trump, with the pair having a good relationship to date. But Trump recently called for former Apple CEO Tim Cook to take over at Nvidia . Outside of the White House, Huang has other concerns to deal with. Congress has summoned him to appear before a Select Committee over his affair with the suspected Chinese spy, threatening to subpoena him if necessary .

title: 法国世界报 - 中国经济战略：中国正竭尽全力，让世界其他国家无法摆脱对自己的依赖
summary: 总部位于巴黎的德洛尔研究所(Jacques Delors Institute)的高级研究员埃尔维尔·法布里（Elvire Fabry）周一在法国世界报上发表文章说，中国正在竭尽全力，确保世界其他国家无法摆脱对中国的依赖。但面对这一局面，欧洲目前仍然拥有重要筹码。 文章表示，中国的经济战略已经不再是传统意义上的自给自足。中国正在通过扩大自身的产业优势，让其他国家越来越离不开中国。 **冲击的性质变了** 中国对西方国家经济冲击的性质已经发生了变化。 中国不再只是生产低价的T恤衫
content:
总部位于巴黎的德洛尔研究所(Jacques Delors Institute)的高级研究员埃尔维尔·法布里（Elvire Fabry）周一在法国世界报上发表文章说，中国正在竭尽全力，确保世界其他国家无法摆脱对中国的依赖。但面对这一局面，欧洲目前仍然拥有重要筹码。

文章表示，中国的经济战略已经不再是传统意义上的自给自足。中国正在通过扩大自身的产业优势，让其他国家越来越离不开中国。

**冲击的性质变了**

中国对西方国家经济冲击的性质已经发生了变化。

中国不再只是生产低价的T恤衫。如今，中国还在机床、化工、制药和云计算等领域展开竞争。其生产成本比法国低40%。

中国在人形机器人领域已经取得领先优势。同时，中国也在人工智能、量子计算和生物技术领域成为重要的创新中心。

对于包括法国在内的欧洲企业来说，问题已不再只是如何保护自身的创新成果。现在，更重要的是如何获得中国的创新技术。

**国家资本主义模式**

中国的这一转变源于中国实行的有计划的国家资本主义模式。

根据经济合作与发展组织（OECD）的数据，中国企业获得的补贴是该组织成员国企业的三至八倍。中国的各省之间展开激烈的竞争。随后，中国共产党通过有组织的产业整合，培育出能够参与全球竞争的行业巨头。

以稀土产业为例。2016年，北京将这一行业整合为六家国有集团，随后又进一步集中为两大巨头。

如今，中国掌握着全球92%的稀土加工产能。这些金属元素已经成为现代经济不可或缺的原材料。

此外，中国正在加快扩大海外市场，加快海外布局。2026年上半年，中国出口额再次增长近18%。推动这一增长的主要是中间产品，包括电池材料、药品活性成分等在内的中间产品。这些产品为世界各地的工厂提供原材料和零部件，它们已经成为世界各地工厂生产过程中不可缺少的一部分。从矿山开采到产品出口，中国正在有计划地让本国供应商在世界范围内取代外国供应商。

**限制技术出口**

与此同时，中国也在封锁技术出口的渠道。自2023年12月以来，中国禁止出口稀土加工技术。去年10月16日，中国又将40项技术纳入管制范围，涉及人工智能、生物医学和光伏产业。

中国一方面让自己的中间产品成为世界其他国家无法绕过的原材料，另一方面，中国还在努力不让世界其他国家获得自己的相关技术。从稀土加工技术到人工智能、生物医学和光伏技术，北京不断加强技术出口管制，限制关键技术向外流动。

**让世界其他国家依赖自己**

因此，中国的经济目标不再只是自给自足了，而是要让世界其他国家依赖自己，要让世界其他国家无法摆脱对中国的依赖。

而依赖本身就是一种武器。

今年1月以来，北京通过限制稀土供应，开始对日本国防工业施加压力。今天发生在东京当局身上的事情，明天也可能发生在法国身上。而且，风险并不只涉及军工领域。

**欧洲不是没有筹码**

埃尔维尔·法布里表示，面对这一局面，欧洲目前仍然拥有重要筹码。随着美国市场对中国的限制增加，对中国的出口来说，欧洲市场的重要性进一步上升。中国需要欧洲市场消化其庞大的工业产能。因此，欧洲应当利用这一优势，为中国企业进入欧洲市场设定明确条件，而不是简单地选择全面开放或关闭市场。

埃尔维尔·法布里认为，欧洲需要采取四项行动：

第一，要明确：关键领域 特别是国防、医疗、能源和数字技术，要减少 不可接受的对外依赖，并建立战略储备。

第二，我们应当规定，中国企业只有在欧洲本地生产、与欧洲企业建立合作关系，并向欧洲转让技术的情况下，才能获得公共采购合同和欧洲援助资金。

第三，建立共同反制机制，避免中国通过分别谈判 来分化 欧洲国家。

第四，加强与日本、加拿大、韩国和印度等可信赖伙伴的合作，共同恢复关键产业的生产能力，并增加对技术创新的投资。

相关文章表示，这些任务不是法国单独能够完成的。法国必须推动欧洲形成统一的经济安全战略。未来，法国和欧洲真正需要思考的，不只是如何控制公共开支，而是如何保持自身的工业基础、技术创新能力和经济自主权。否则，今天的经济依赖，可能成为明天难以摆脱的战略约束。

圖為一名俄羅斯藝術家的畫作描繪美國總統川普、俄羅斯總統普丁和中國國家主席習近平在APEC領袖多邊會議會面。（路透社）
（中央社記者張謙香港17日電）美國、中國和俄羅斯元首確定在即將舉行的亞太經濟合作組織（APEC）領袖峰會期間會晤，有香港媒體表示，由於三國之間尚有很多化解不了的矛盾與分歧，達成具體協議的機會不高。
港媒信報今天發表社評表示，三國元首展開峰會，誠屬舉世矚目之事，但如果將之比擬為重建國際秩序的「雅爾達會議2.0」，則未免過度解讀。原因在於三國之間尚有很多化解不了的矛盾與分歧，達成具體協議的機會不高，遑論其他涉及各國利益分配的複雜決定。
社評認為，深圳不會成為另一個雅爾達，原因在於美中俄峰會僅是溝通的起點，暫時看不到達成共識的可能。
美國方面的消息也透露，三方峰會將討論包括削減核武器在內的許多議題，川普沒有計畫談及輝達前執行長黃仁勳婚外情對象涉及間諜的傳聞，也一度傳出無意與中俄領導人磋商烏克蘭問題。
明報在報導中也引述上海政法學院教授倪樂雄說，所謂「雅爾達2.0」完全是牽強附會，是「假李逵」，並指當年雅爾達三巨頭（美英蘇）是大戰勝利者，「一言九鼎地處理戰利品，現在美俄都栽在小國手裏，根本沒有可比性，徒有其表」。
報導又引述美國專家甘思德（Scott Kennedy）說，三國元首峰會時間很短，且三方在最重要的具體議題（例如烏克蘭、伊朗、關稅或出口管制等）上都有重大分歧，「我揣測他們會做的是重申大國（great powers）應有最大發言權，這會令其他中等強權（medium-sized powers）影響力下降而感到不滿」。
根據網上資料，所謂的雅爾達會議（Yalta Conference），是1945年納粹德國敗局已定之時，美國總統羅斯福（Franklin D Roosevelt）、英國首相邱吉爾（Winston Churchill）與蘇聯領袖史達林（Joseph Stalin）在蘇聯的克里米亞雅爾達皇宮舉行會議，制定戰後世界新秩序和列強利益分配的問題。（編輯：廖文綺）1151117

content:
【大紀元2026年11月17日訊】（大紀元記者鍾又淳報導）香港殿堂級歌手林子祥與葉蒨文夫婦，去年在香港紅館開啟的《白頭到老WE ARE ONE》世界巡迴演唱會，日前移師中國南京舉行。針對先前在重慶站險些跌落舞台的驚險插曲，葉蒨文大方自嘲「我只是老了」，幽默向歌迷報平安。
葉蒨文先前在重慶站演唱《信自己》時，因舞台燈光昏暗加上轉身失去平衡，她一度向前傾倒險些摔下舞台，令粉絲捏了一把冷汗。所幸身旁伴舞演員眼疾手快將其攔腰拉住，避免了意外發生。葉蒨文隨後幽默向觀眾表示「太嚇人了，太興奮了，耳朵不平衡，舞台好黑」，並向伴舞演員致謝。
在11月14日的南京演唱會上，葉蒨文再次穿上閃亮背心挑戰同一首舞曲。演出後，她笑著提及自己因險些摔下舞台而登上新聞，並表示許多親友致電表示關心，她笑說「我只是老了，不小心跌了一跤」，讓全場觀眾不用擔心。
現年79歲的林子祥與65歲的葉蒨文，在長達3小時的演出中展現驚人的體力。從開場的《十分十二吋》、中段的《成吉思汗》到安可曲《狂歡》皆全程唱跳，絲毫未受先前險些跌落舞台事故的影響。
林子祥與葉蒨文的愛情是一段跨越數十載、充滿爭議但也極其深情和契合的傳奇。兩人被譽為華語樂壇的「天作之合」，雙方的音樂合作貫穿數十年，涵蓋了經典對唱歌曲、幕後製作扶持、以及大大小小的演唱會與音綜舞台。從《選擇》到《重逢》，兩人的對唱默契十足，情感張力極強。雙方因在音樂理念上高度共振，多次以夫妻檔形式舉行世界巡迴演唱會。
隨著年紀增長，林子祥與葉蒨文在舞台上或是私下被捕捉到的互動愈發萌趣。兩人時常像小孩一樣打鬧嬉戲，舉手投足間展現出老夫老妻特有的默契與甜蜜。兩人常在舞台上深情對望，互豎大拇指，將對彼此的理解和寵溺融入歌聲之中。
在最近的巡演中，兩人不僅各自展現高難度唱功，更在串場與合唱中頻頻互動。無論是葉蒨文活力四射的唱跳，還是林子祥穩如泰山的鐵肺高音，兩人在舞台上始終互相照應，踐行了「唱到老、愛到老」的承諾。
隨著在南京站為2026年內地巡演畫下句點，林子祥葉蒨文夫婦將於12月中旬移師美國拉斯維加斯及三藩市演出，並計劃於2027年舉辦《白頭到老Encore》場次。

content:
Fundraiser by Uyghur Anthology : Support the Contemporary Uyghur Anthology
This anthology funds Uyghur writers and artists, translation, events, and community growth
Uyghur Anthology is organizing this fundraiser.
The Contemporary Uyghur Anthology is a publication that platforms Uyghur (and anyone drawing their roots from East Turkistan) artists and writers in the diaspora by providing a space that is often inaccessible to those in our community. There are no other projects of its kind in the English language, and with two volumes already published, we hope to take this project to the next level. It's a rare look at Uyghur expression in an environment where all our stories are told by people pushing their own narratives without the intimate knowledge of our lived experiences.
<"Manifesto" by Sumayah Jurad from Vol. II>
We asked ourselves these questions - why wait for others to invite us to the table when we can pull up a chair and introduce ourselves? Why let others speak for us without trying first to speak? Our broken English can only be improved with audacity, and world literature is only enriched by the presence of new voices.
All-in-all, our efforts have been met with support from our community and pleasant surprise from those who did not know what they did not know.
Somewhat unprecedented is that we publish the authors' original language alongside the translation. Our book is filled with Uyghur, Latin, Cyrillic, and Chinese script to encapsulate as much of our community's experience as we can.
There are many publications in diaspora communities that platform East and South Asians, SEA, MENA, and more. Central Asia is often underrepresented in world literature or Asia-specific publications, and occupied territories even less so. Uyghurs themselves have been a relatively new diaspora community in English-speaking countries, and haven't had the opportunities to grow their literary or artistic communities. Many don't have the tools to nurture their talents, or knowledge of creative networks or opportunities, even when many journals seek work from underrepresented groups. In instances where they are aware, it's difficult to be published in this competitive field without the education and styles that publications look for. There are only a handful of literary translators translating from Uyghur to English, and not many Uyghurs who have had the chances to develop their creative language when learning English.
To sum up, the issues were:
No spaces for Uyghur writers and artists to develop their skills
A disconnect from artist communities, be it local or online
No bridge between our native tongue and English, and in turn, world literature
So, we put together a small group at the Tarim Network to take on this challenge. Completely volunteer-run; the very essence of a passion project. We did a call-out for anything and all. New writers, established writers, any language, any genre, whatever we could print in a book. And here we were, the first book of its kind, created to speak for ourselves without outsider voices, without a publishing house, raw and straight from the source.
<From the launch of Vol. I at Harvard University>
"The Contemporary Uyghur Anthology is a collection of Uyghur reflections in diaspora. Weaving together memories of the homeland, experiences of displacement, and transitions of identities, this anthology is a creative reflection of the beauty and complexities of the Uyghur experience.
By centering Uyghur voices at the forefront, this anthology serves as a form of living memory in a pivotal moment of Uyghur history. The title Under the Mulberry Tree refers to a story from the Uyghur literary classic Ana Yurt, where youthful Nuri faces terrible injustices, separation, and turmoil; but for one moment in the Charbagh, his love for Sebihe and his own family is full, ripe, and sweet, like the mulberries from the ancient tree. In a similar way that the mulberry tree offered comforts in Nuri’s time of need, we hope this volume offers a place of reflection and celebration of Uyghur culture."
We'd partnered with a member from a Jewish organisation to run writing workshops and explain editorial processes, as we had never worked on something like this before. After that collaboration, we decided to publish a revised edition on our own. This time, we added editors' notes to the pages to explain certain terms and historical and cultural contexts - mainly for our own youth, who don't always have access to cultural education. We translated more pieces from Uyghur and Chinese. Our contributors spanned 13 countries, at all levels of experience.
Was this work sustainable? Equipped with the tools, experience, and outpouring of support from our first volume, we spent the next two years saying yes. Our first book was now in libraries, there were articles and academic papers that mentioned it, and most of all, we reaffirmed the need for this sort of work. Not only were we accepting submissions, we worked one-on-one with emerging writers and artists to edit their pieces. We also helped first-time translators have their first publications with help from more experienced translators, as well as connecting them with the original authors.
Our second volume was even better than the last. From the blurb:
"How do we respond to the unexpected, and how does it influence perceptions of ourselves or the environments in which we exist? As a diaspora population, unexpected encounters can shape and transform what it means to be Uyghur as we build a new life outside of the homeland. Encounters Under the Mulberry Tree takes on the literal, abstract, and expanded renditions of these moments. We feature contemporary and historical works, including art, poetry, and prose in five languages with contributors based in a dozen countries, from established writers like award-winning author and filmmaker Tahir Hamut Izgil, to emerging artists, writers and translators of all ages. This book is a library of vignettes that grapple with intersections and how we make sense of it all."
Five languages (Uyghur, English, Chinese, Russian, Turkish)
<Vol. II showcased at a college hosted by Rawan Mentorship>
Now we embark on our third volume. The three of us do this while maintaining full time jobs, academic careers, and other side projects. We all live in different countries and have only met in person once. But it's something that we need to do, for our community and for ourselves. Our contributors have gained so much from this experience and we want to extend this opportunity to more people. This needs to survive in order for similar initiatives to be born.
Supporting the editors - all expenses so far have been paid out-of-pocket or through book sales. We do not have any donors or sponsors (yet!).
Supporting our contributors - we cannot afford to pay any of our contributors. Despite this, we have given free copies of the book to contributors, but this is definitely leaving a dent in our pockets.
Recruiting more people - paid internships or remuneration for one-off work would help volunteers spend more time on this project in this economy.
Enhance our level of expertise - we want to improve. Workshops or courses for our editors and contributors, professional feedback, the works. Unfortunately there is no one who speaks Uyghur and who is involved in Western publishing or English literature on a professional or academic level. We would appreciate connections with professionals from any language background, or the funding to level up.
Expand our network - we'd love to promote our work at literary festivals, go to conferences, do book events, establish ourselves in the public eye, provide reader copies to reviewers, and so on. However, there is a funding barrier to overcome to be able to attend these events, organise, or pre-order books.
<Vol. I on display at the Mosquers Film Festival, 2025>
Munawwar Abdulla is an Uyghur advocate, poet, and scientist born on unceded Kaurna land (Australia) and based in Massachusetts. She co-founded The Tarim Network, runs Uyghur Collective, and collaborates on projects with Uyghur rights organisations around the world. Her writings and literary translations have been published in places such as Modern Poetry in Translation, Asymptote, the Margins, the Georgia Review, and others.
Sonya Imin is a mixed Uyghur American scholar and multi-disciplinary creative who has worked on art and film projects across the US, Europe, and Central Asia. Growing up between the borderlands of the Uyghur homeland, broader Central Asia, and the midwestern United States, interrogations of belonging, home, and displacement influence the nature of her work. Currently based in Brussels, she is working on her doctoral research on Uyghur artistic production in the diaspora.
Maidina Kadeer is a mixed Uyghur-Hui writer and editor, born in Ghulja and currently based in Montreal (Tiohtià:ke), Canada. She holds a BA in English Literature and Law and Society from Concordia University, with a focus on post- and neo-colonial literature. Her work explores Uyghur identity, history, and culture through cuisine, agriculture, and neo-colonialism. She has contributed to projects such as a poem, NinetySix, in Slavs and Tatars’ Contest of the Fruits (2021) and participates in panels and interviews on Agriculture and Food History to raise awareness about Uyghur culture.

A busy street in Kigali, Rwanda, in April 2024 | Jacques Nkinzingabo / The New York Times

Vienna – Germany, Denmark, Austria, Greece and the Netherlands on Monday unveiled a plan to establish a migrant deportation center in Rwanda — the first such facility outside the European Union.
The group has stepped up efforts to open a “return hub” for rejected migrants after the EU cleared the way by toughening migration rules.
The move came despite protests from human rights groups and a warning from the United Nations refugee agency UNHCR. France’s President Emmanuel Macron has also expressed doubts.

11 月 4 日，匈牙利总理彼得·马扎尔 (Peter Magyar) 在布达佩斯举行的新闻发布会上发表讲话，匈牙利开始在在线公共数据库中发布数万份共产主义时代的警察档案。 |路透社

匈牙利期待已久的关于共产主义时代合作者的秘密档案的公布并没有像总理彼得·马扎尔（Peter Magyar）计划的那样进行。

title: 菲律宾外长：中国仍致力完成南中国海行为准则谈判 1小时前
summary: 11月16日，在菲律宾马尼拉举行的第49届亚细安峰会期间，出席亚细安—中国峰会的各国领导人及代表手拉手合影。左起为缅甸代表埃埃丁、马来西亚首相安华、泰国首相阿努廷、东帝汶总理夏纳纳、越南总理黎明兴、中国总理李强、菲律宾总统小马可斯、新加坡总理黄循财、文莱苏丹哈桑纳尔、印尼总统普拉博沃、柬埔寨副首相洪尊那隆，以及老挝总理沙伦赛。 （路透社） 菲律宾外长拉萨罗说，中国仍致力于与亚细安完成《南中国海行为准则》谈判。尽管双方已对约八成草案条文达成初步共识，但无法实现今年完成谈判的目标
content:
11月16日，在菲律宾马尼拉举行的第49届亚细安峰会期间，出席亚细安—中国峰会的各国领导人及代表手拉手合影。左起为缅甸代表埃埃丁、马来西亚首相安华、泰国首相阿努廷、东帝汶总理夏纳纳、越南总理黎明兴、中国总理李强、菲律宾总统小马可斯、新加坡总理黄循财、文莱苏丹哈桑纳尔、印尼总统普拉博沃、柬埔寨副首相洪尊那隆，以及老挝总理沙伦赛。 （路透社）
菲律宾外长拉萨罗说，中国仍致力于与亚细安完成《南中国海行为准则》谈判。尽管双方已对约八成草案条文达成初步共识，但无法实现今年完成谈判的目标。
综合菲律宾《每日问询者报》《马尼拉时报》报道，拉萨罗星期一（11月16日）在新闻发布会上说，中国总理李强当天在亚细安—中国峰会上重申支持尽早达成《南中国海行为准则》，与北京过去作出的承诺一致。
她指出，中国与亚细安一直致力于完成行为准则谈判，如果北京改变立场，将在亚细安内部引起争议。
拉萨罗说，虽然行为准则无法在菲律宾担任亚细安轮值主席国期间完成，但马尼拉并不感到失望。在菲律宾今年推动的多轮谈判下，双方已达成初步共识的草案条文比例，从约50%提高至约80%。
她说：“我们为什么要感到失望？我们只是需要更多时间，但我们必须停下来，把工作交给下一个轮值主席国。”
拉萨罗指出，尽管菲律宾推动双方每个月举行谈判，仍没有足够时间完成协议。她认为，如果再多五六个月，谈判或许就能完成，但目前无法提供确切时间表，希望新加坡明年能够推动谈判取得进一步进展。
亚细安与中国2023年同意加快谈判，争取在2026年完成《南中国海行为准则》，以制定管理海上争端、防止冲突升级的规则。菲律宾总统小马可斯此前也将完成谈判，列为菲国担任亚细安轮值主席国的主要目标之一。
不过，尽管谈判已进入最后阶段，各方在行为准则是否具有法律约束力等关键问题上，仍存在分歧。
中国与亚细安2002年签署《南中国海各方行为宣言》，并于2017年正式启动行为准则谈判。近年来，中国与菲律宾因南中国海主权和海洋权益争议屡次发生海上对峙，也凸显建立有效危机管控机制的迫切性。

title: 卡尼周二会晤习近平 商讨粮食、能源及金融服务合作 1小时前
summary: 加拿大总理卡尼将于星期二（11月17日）在亚太经济合作组织（APEC）会议召开前夕，与中国国家主席习近平会晤，寻求深化两国在粮食、能源及金融服务领域的合作。 据路透社报道，卡尼今年1月访问中国，成为近10年来首位访华的加拿大总理。此次访问是他推动加拿大减少对美国经济高度依赖的重要战略举措之一。 星期二在深圳举行的会晤，将是卡尼出任总理以来第三次与习近平会面。两人此前曾在去年于韩国举行的APEC会议期间会晤。 卡尼星期天（11月15日）说，与习近平会晤时，也将讨论中国在国际体系
content:
加拿大总理卡尼将于星期二（11月17日）在亚太经济合作组织（APEC）会议召开前夕，与中国国家主席习近平会晤，寻求深化两国在粮食、能源及金融服务领域的合作。
据路透社报道，卡尼今年1月访问中国，成为近10年来首位访华的加拿大总理。此次访问是他推动加拿大减少对美国经济高度依赖的重要战略举措之一。
星期二在深圳举行的会晤，将是卡尼出任总理以来第三次与习近平会面。两人此前曾在去年于韩国举行的APEC会议期间会晤。
卡尼星期天（11月15日）说，与习近平会晤时，也将讨论中国在国际体系中角色的变化。
卡尼说：“这是我上任以来推动加中经济关系正常化进程的一部分。”他这番话也间接提及加拿大前总理特鲁多执政期间，两国关系一度紧张。
另据法新社报道，卡尼星期一（16日）说，如果美国总统特朗普加征关税，导致北美汽车产业的一体化格局进一步受到削弱，加拿大汽车制造商可能转向中国。
特朗普去年对加拿大汽车业加征惩罚性关税，并多次表示他希望所有在美国销售的汽车，都只由美国工人制造。
卡尼今年8月退出与特朗普的贸易谈判，但近几个星期以来，加拿大和美国都对达成协议的前景表示乐观。
卡尼说，考虑转向中国“不是为了增加谈判筹码，而是采取行动、作出回应”。
批评人士警告，加拿大与中国关系日益密切，可能危及加拿大的国家安全。北京此前监禁了香港传媒大亨黎智英，去年还秘密处决了四名加拿大公民。加拿大也发现了中国干预至少两届联邦选举的证据。在此背景下，卡尼仍有意扩大与中国的经贸往来，引发人权团体批评。中国则表示，无意干涉加拿大内政。
路透社引述战略治国方略中心（Centre for Strategic Statecraft）智库联合创始人纳吉布拉说：“卡尼已经完成了稳定对华关系这项艰巨任务，但如今面临更大的挑战，就是如何在有选择地开展对华经济合作的同时，维护加拿大的经济和国家安全。”
纳吉布拉说：“加拿大需要明确如何处理这些敏感问题，目前还不清楚加方是否已向中方充分说明具体的应对方式。”
卡尼多次称，与中国接触并不意味着认同中国的立场。他也说，加拿大必须与那些希望推动其作出改变的国家保持往来。

防衛省は17日、ロシア機とみられる航空機2機が同日、福岡県沖ノ島北西で領空侵犯したと発表した。航空自衛隊西部航空方面隊の戦闘機が緊急発進（スクランブル）して対応した。

Japan on Tuesday delivered a strong protest to Moscow after two suspected Russian military planes entered Japanese airspace off Fukuoka Prefecture, prompting the Air Self-Defense Force to scramble fighter jets.
The Defense Ministry in Tokyo said the ASDF fighters issued warnings and took other unspecified measures toward the apparent Russian aircraft after they separately entered Japanese airspace near Fukuoka’s Okinoshima island for several minutes at around 4 a.m. on Tuesday.
The suspected Russian aircraft continued their flights, passing through the Tsushima Strait and then flying between Okinawa Prefecture’s Yonaguni Island and Taiwan before entering the western Pacific Ocean.

title: Launch Preview: Ariane 6 to launch Amazon satellites, Falcon 9 to launch government missions
zh_title: 发射预览：阿丽亚娜 6 号将发射亚马逊卫星，猎鹰 9 号将发射政府任务
summary: 经过一周繁忙的发射活动，本周全球发射清单预计将进行六次发射，其中包括范登堡发射的 3 次 SpaceX 猎鹰 9 号发射任务、中国的两次发射任务以及南美洲的阿丽亚娜 6 号发射任务。 SpaceX 将为美国太空部队和国家侦察办公室发射有效载荷，而本周的中国任务和阿丽亚娜 6 号任务中至少有一次将发射一批互联网卫星。长征2D |有效载荷未知 11 月 18 日星期三，中国将发射长征 2D (CZ-2D) 火箭，预计将从 9 号发射场 (LC
content:
经过一周繁忙的发射活动，本周全球发射清单预计将进行六次发射，其中包括范登堡发射的 3 次 SpaceX 猎鹰 9 号发射任务、中国的两次发射任务以及南美洲的阿丽亚娜 6 号发射任务。 SpaceX 将为美国太空部队和国家侦察办公室发射有效载荷，而本周的中国任务和阿丽亚娜 6 号任务中至少有一次将发射一批互联网卫星。长征2D |有效载荷未知，将于 11 月 18 日星期三从中国发射，长征 2D (CZ-2D) 预计将于世界标准时间 22:50 从太原卫星发射中心的 9 号发射场 (LC-9) 发射。官方警告通知表明发射轨迹是向南的，但有效载荷及其预定轨道的详细信息要等到发射后才会发布。两级、40.77 米高的 CZ-2D 由上海航天技术研究院 (SAST) 制造。 2D 版本不需要额外的捆绑式助推器。此次飞行将是长征2D的第108次飞行，也是今年的第七次。猎鹰 9 号 | USSF-317 (R-6) SpaceX 将于 11 月 18 日星期三进行本周两次发射中的第一次发射，发射时间为四小时，发射窗口于太平洋标准时间晚上 7:00（世界标准时间周四 03:00）开始。
USSF-317 任务是美国太空军 (USSF) 本周的唯一任务，将从加利福尼亚州范登堡太空部队基地 (VSFB) 的东 4 号航天发射场 (SLC-4E) 发射，向东南飞行，将其机密有效载荷送入低地球轨道 (LEO)。所有系统看起来都很好，天气也有利于升空。猎鹰 9 号发射的 USSF-627 任务即将开始从加利福尼亚州发射推进剂 → https://t.co/IdlZbviZZl pic.twitter.com/fKxyN4DIui — SpaceX (@SpaceX) 2026 年 11 月 12 日助推器 B1100 将支持此次任务，这是自近一年前 11 月 23 日首次支持星链集团 11-30 以来的第十一次飞行， 2025 年。除了 NROL-105 和 USSF-385 之外，助推器之前的八次飞行支持了星链任务。 SpaceX 的西海岸无人机飞船 Of Course I Still Love You 将在 B1100 升空后约 8 分钟着陆时驻扎在地面。猎鹰 9 号是一枚直径 3.9 米、高 70 米的两级火箭。九台 Merlin 1D 发动机为第一级助推器提供动力，而第二级则使用一台真空优化的 Merlin 发动机。猎鹰 9 号和猎鹰重型火箭是第一批实现定期重复使用的轨道火箭，其中一枚猎鹰助推器已飞行 37 次。飞行后，两个有效载荷整流罩也被回收并重复使用。长征8A | SatNet LEO Group 本周的第二次中国发射计划于 11 月 11 日星期五举行。
世界标准时间 20 日 11:00，在中国文昌航天发射场的商业 LC-1 发射台上发射。长征 8A (CZ-8A) 将携带 9 颗通信卫星进入近地轨道，这些卫星由 SatNet 拥有并由中国卫星网络集团运营。 CZ-8A火箭有两个直径3.35米的级，总高度为50.54 m。第一级由两个捆绑式液体燃料助推器辅助。此次飞行将是 CZ-8A 的第 13 次飞行，也是 2026 年的第七次飞行。 NROL-136 SpaceX 本周的第二次猎鹰 9 号任务定于 11 月 21 日星期六太平洋标准时间凌晨 4:30（世界标准时间 12:30）发射，同样是从加州 VSFB 的 SLC-4E 发射。 NROL-136 任务将携带未知数量的有效载荷进入近地轨道，供国家侦察办公室 (NRO) 的增殖建筑星座使用，该星座由 Space 建造

【原文 English Original】
Following a week of busy launch activity, the worldwide launch manifest is set to see six launches this week, with three SpaceX Falcon 9 missions from Vandenberg, two Chinese missions, and an Ariane 6 mission from South America. SpaceX will launch payloads for the United States Space Force and the National Reconnaissance Office, while at least one of this week’s Chinese missions and the Ariane 6 will launch a batch of internet satellites. Chang Zheng 2D | Unknown Payload Wednesday, Nov. 18, will see a launch from China, with a Chang Zheng 2D (CZ-2D) expected to launch from Launch Complex 9 (LC-9) at the Taiyuan Satellite Launch Center at 22:50 UTC. Official warning notices indicate a southerly launch trajectory, but details of the payload and its intended orbit will not be released until after launch. The two-stage, 40.77-m-tall CZ-2D is manufactured by the Shanghai Academy of Spaceflight Technology (SAST). The 2D variant requires no additional strap-on boosters. This flight will mark the 108th CZ-2D to fly, the seventh of this year. Falcon 9 | USSF-317 (R-6) SpaceX’s first of two launches this week comes on Wednesday, Nov. 18, at the start of a four-hour launch window that opens at 7:00 PM PST (03:00 UTC on Thursday). The only mission for the United States Space Force (USSF) this week, the USSF-317 mission will launch from Space Launch Complex 4 East (SLC-4E) at Vandenberg Space Force Base (VSFB) in California, flying southeast to place its classified payload into low-Earth orbit (LEO). All systems are looking good, and weather is favorable for liftoff. Propellant load is about to begin for Falcon 9’s launch of the USSF-627 mission from California → https://t.co/IdlZbviZZl pic.twitter.com/fKxyN4DIui — SpaceX (@SpaceX) November 12, 2026 Booster B1100 will support this mission, marking its eleventh flight since first supporting Starlink Group 11-30 nearly a year ago on Nov. 23, 2025. Eight of the booster’s previous flights supported Starlink missions, in addition to flying NROL-105 and USSF-385. SpaceX’s west coast droneship, Of Course I Still Love You, will be stationed downrange for B1100’s landing approximately eight minutes after liftoff. Falcon 9 is a 3.9-m-diameter, 70-m-tall two-stage rocket. Nine Merlin 1D engines power the first-stage booster, while the second stage uses a single vacuum-optimized Merlin engine. Falcon 9 and Falcon Heavy were the first orbital rockets to achieve regular re-use, with one Falcon booster having flown 37 flights. The two payload fairings are also recovered and reused after flight. Chang Zheng 8A | SatNet LEO Group The second Chinese launch of the week is scheduled for Friday, Nov. 20, at 11:00 UTC from the Commercial LC-1 pad at the Wenchang Space Launch Site in China. A Chang Zheng 8A (CZ-8A) will carry nine communications satellites into LEO, with the satellites owned by SatNet and operated by the China Satellite Network Group. The CZ-8A rocket features two 3.35-m-diameter stages, with a total height of 50.54 m. The first stage is assisted by two strap-on liquid-fuelled boosters. This flight will mark the 13th overall CZ-8A flight, the seventh of 2026. Falcon 9 | NROL-136 SpaceX’s second Falcon 9 mission of the week is scheduled to launch on Saturday, Nov. 21, at 4:30 AM PST (12:30 UTC), again from SLC-4E at VSFB in California. The NROL-136 mission will carry an unknown number of payloads into LEO for the National Reconnaissance Office’s (NRO) Proliferated Architecture constellation, built by SpaceX and Northrop Grumman. The booster supporting this mission will be B1097, flying for the 14th time. This booster first flew on Sept. 3, 2025, and has previously flown eight Starlink missions, as well as NROL-172, Transporter 17, Sentinel-6B, Twilight (Pandora & Others), and USSF-259. Following stage separation, B1097 will conduct a return-to-launch-site landing at Landing Zone 4 (LZ-4), located directly next to SLC-4E. Ariane 64 | Amazon Leo (LE-04) Amazon is continuing to put together its constellation of Leo satellites and will add another 36 on Monday, Nov. 23, at 10:12 UTC aboard an Ariane 64. The rocket will launch from Ensemble de Lancement Ariane 4 (ELA-4) at the Guiana Space Centre in French Guiana, with the launch window lasting five hours and 27 minutes. Ariane 64 will follow a northeastern trajectory, delivering 22,000 kg of Leo satellites into LEO. Ariane 64 is a 62-m-tall, 5.4-m-diameter, expendable two-stage rocket built by the ArianeGroup on behalf of the European Space Agency. Both stages are powered by liquid hydrogen and oxygen-fuelled engines. The 64 variant of the basic Ariane 6 utilizes four P129 strap-on solid rocket boosters to provide additional lift-off thrust. This will be the fifth Ariane 6 mission of 2026. Watch the full replay of #VA269 . Relive Ariane 6's successful mission carrying 36 Amazon Leo satellites into orbit. First flight with P160C boosters Heaviest Ariane payload ever #LaunchingAmbitions #Ariane6 #VA269 @Amazonleo @ArianeGroup @esa @CNES @EuropeSpacePort pic.twitter.com/YLxW60wAo1 — Arianespace (@Arianespace) June 17, 2026 Falcon 9 | USSF-266 (TH-3) Closing out the week, a Falcon 9 launch is currently scheduled for Monday, Nov. 23, at 8:04 AM PST (16:04 UTC) — the third this week from SLC-4E at VSFB. The classified USSF-266 mission has a four-hour launch window extending to 12:04 PM PST (20:04 UTC). Falcon 9 will fly due south, indicating a polar orbit for the payload. While the payload is classified, the launch trajectory and other factors suggest that this may be an additional batch of satellites for the USSF’s Space-Based Airborne Moving Target Indicator (SB-AMTI) program. These are based on the SpaceX Starshield satellite bus. The Falcon 9 booster supporting this flight will be B1081, making its 29th flight. B1081 first flew on Aug. 26, 2023, and flew four missions from SpaceX’s Florida launch sites before moving to Vandenberg for Transporter 10, where it has operated since then. The booster will land atop Of Course I Still Love You , stationed approximately 640 km downrange in the Pacific Ocean. If the current schedule holds, this will mark the 122nd Falcon 9 flight of 2026, and the 273rd orbital launch attempt worldwide in 2026. (Lead Image: Falcon 9 launches into the Florida morning skies. Credit: Julia Bergeron for NSF) The post Launch Preview: Ariane 6 to launch Amazon satellites, Falcon 9 to launch government missions appeared first on NASASpaceFlight.com .
